entries.B4.1 (tốt tiến chiếu) cũng chiếu hết nga: P4+1 (the Soldier advances with check) also mates at once.
entries.Bình pháo tạo pháo chồng trên lộ 3 để bắ: Shift the Cannon to stack the Cannons on file 3 and attack Black's Chariot on file 7, then trade the Chariot for Black's Cannon on file 7, and finally the front Cannon uses a Black Horse as its screen to win back the Chariot. Red ends a full Cannon up.
entries.Bẫy cần tránh: M7/8 hoặc M7/9 cũng mở đư: Trap to avoid: H7-8 or H7-9 also opens the line for the Cannon's check, but only as a single check; Black pulls the Chariot on file 3 back to the back rank (R3-8) between the Cannon and the Advisor and escapes. You must play H7-6 for the double check, and then blocking the Cannon's line no longer helps.
entries.Bắt buộc phải ăn lại xe: nếu chạy tướng: Red must take back the Chariot: if the General moves (K5=6), Red is checkmated in 3 moves. If A4-5 blocks, R5+4 takes the Advisor with check, K5=4, R5=7 (the Chariot leaves the file and the Horse on file 4 checks) checkmate. If E3+5 blocks, R5+3 takes the Elephant with check and mates in 3 moves.
entries.Chiếu liên tục: thí tốt kéo tướng sang l: Check without a break: sacrifice a Soldier to pull the General to file 4, shift the Cannon on file 7 to use an Advisor as a screen and push the General back, take an Advisor with the Horse with check to force the General to take the Cannon and move up to the second rank, then the Chariot on file 1 runs along the second rank taking the Cannon and the two blocking Chariots in turn and delivers checkmate.
entries.Chạy xe khỏi đòn bắt của mã nhưng chạy c: Move the Chariot away from the Horse's attack, but with a purpose: the Chariot shifts to file 8 and attacks the Black Cannon. Black counterattacks by trading the Horse for a Cannon with check, and Red takes back the Horse with an Advisor: the result is a Cannon up.
entries.Chỉ có hai mã nên đỏ không thể chiếu liê: With only two Horses, Red cannot check without a break; this exercise tests your ability to find quiet moves. If Red is slow, Black brings an Advisor back to the middle of the palace (A6-5) or brings the Cannon back to defend, and the two Horses can no longer force mate.
entries.Chỉ dùng tốt để chiếu hết: tốt ăn xe chi: Checkmate with Soldiers only: a Soldier takes the Chariot with check and drives the General back to the back rank, then two quiet Soldier moves (no check) build a mating net, and finally a Soldier gives checkmate.
entries.Các nước mã khác cũng thắng nhưng phải m: Other Horse moves also win but take a few more moves; only H8-6 mates at once.
entries.Dù mã nào chặn (Ms.4 hay Mt/4), B6.1 vẫn: Whichever Horse blocks (-H+4 or +H-4), P6+1 still mates.
entries.Dù đen che bằng sĩ nào hay lên tướng, đỏ: Whichever Advisor Black blocks with, or if the General moves up, Red continues with the discovered check H3-4 and then H4-5 takes the Horse.
entries.Dù đen ăn tốt 5 (X5/3) hay tiếp tục chiế: Whether Black takes the Soldier on file 5 (R5-3) or keeps checking (R5=4), Red keeps the extra material.
entries.Dù đen ăn xe bằng quân nào (M4/5, V3.5 h: Whichever piece Black takes the Chariot with (H4-5, E3+5 or E7-5), Red continues with P7=6 and then C1+3 mates.
entries.Dù đỏ che bằng sĩ nào (S6.5 hay S4.5), đ: Whichever Advisor Red blocks with (A6+5 or A4+5), Black continues with the discovered check R7-5.
entries.Dù đỏ đáp bằng S6.5, Tg4-5 hay S6/5, đen: Whether Red answers with A6+5, K4=5 or A6-5, Black still takes the Cannon with H5-4.
entries.Dùng mã chiếu mở mặt cho xe 8 tấn công,: Use a Horse check to open the way for the Chariot on file 8, then combine it with Red's Chariot and Cannon on file 3 to checkmate.
entries.Dùng mã chiếu đẩy tướng lên tầng 2, pháo: Use a Horse check to push the General up to the second rank, retreat the Cannon to set up a Cannon–Horse check that forces the Black Cannon to block, then the rear Horse takes the Cannon. The two Red Horses end up protecting each other right next to the General, ready to take the Chariot if it checks.
entries.Dùng mã chiếu đẩy tướng lên tầng 3, mã l: Use a Horse check to push the General up to the third rank, retreat the Horse with a quiet move so it becomes the Cannon's screen, take the Black Cannon with the Red General to keep the flying General rule in force, and then shift the Cannon across for checkmate.
entries.Dùng mã ăn xe chiếu, thí tốt để kéo tướn: Take a Chariot with the Horse, giving check, sacrifice a Soldier to pull the General up to the third rank, then let the two Horses take turns checking to win the second Chariot and drive the General back down, and finally use a Horse as the screen for the Cannon on file 6 on the riverbank to deliver checkmate (the Red General locks file 5).
entries.Dùng nước tấn công để mở đường cho xe và: Use attacking moves to open the way for the Chariot to reach file 4 and checkmate.
entries.Dùng tốt đưa các quân phòng thủ quan trọ: Use the Soldiers to drive Black's important defenders onto bad points, and coordinate the pieces to win all of Black's Chariots and checkmate.
entries.Dùng xe bắt chết mã đen, lấy lợi thế quâ: Use the Chariot to trap the Black Horse and gain a strong-piece advantage.
entries.Dùng xe chiếu ép tướng đen lùi để xe 5 đ: Check with the Chariot to force the Black General back so Black's Chariot on file 5 loses its protector, shift the Chariot sideways to take it, then block the Horse's leg with the Cannon to stop the counter-check.
entries.Dùng xe ăn pháo chiếu để vừa hóa giải nư: Take the Cannon with the Chariot, giving check, to stop the check and pull Black's Chariot on file 9 off the back rank; then use the Horse as a screen for a check by the back-rank Cannon, and finish with a Cannon–Horse double check in 3 moves.
entries.Dùng xe ăn pháo đầu để vừa giải chiếu vừ: Take the central Cannon with the Chariot to get out of check and give a counter-check, sacrifice a Soldier to pull Black's Cannon on file 6 off the General's rank, then the Cannon on file 1 mates with the Horse on file 3 as its screen.
entries.Dùng xe ăn tượng chiếu, rồi xe bình ngan: Take the Elephant with the Chariot, giving check; then shift the Chariot sideways so the central Cannon gives a discovered check, using that tempo to bring the Chariot to file 7 and retreat it to take Black's Chariot on file 3, deep in Red's half.
entries.Dùng đôi xe chiếu và mở đáy trống để hai: Check with the pair of Chariots and empty the back rank so the two Red Cannons can combine for the double-Cannon mate.
entries.Dùng đôi xe và mặt tướng để tạo đáy trốn: Use the pair of Chariots and the flying General rule to empty the back rank so the two Red Cannons can attack together and finish with the double-Cannon mate.
entries.Dồn hai xe lên lộ 4 chiếu liên tục, lần: Pile both Chariots onto file 4 and check without a break, taking every Black piece that blocks the way in turn (Soldier, Chariot, Cannon, Horse, Cannon), and accept a Chariot sacrifice at the end so the Horse can finish with help from the Soldier on file 5.
entries.Giải chiếu bằng S6.5 thì thế cờ cân bằng: Getting out of check with A6+5 leaves the game level.
entries.Giải chiếu bằng cách chạy tướng (thay vì: Get out of check by moving the General (instead of taking the Soldier), so that when the Black Chariot greedily takes the Horse, Red's Chariot on file 6 advances to take an Advisor with check and pushes the Black General up to the second rank; the Black General then becomes the screen for the Cannon on file 4 to shift across and take the Chariot.
entries.Giải chiếu bằng cách lui tượng (bỏ ngòi: Get out of check by retreating the Elephant (removing the Black Cannon's screen) while keeping the Horse's threat against the Chariot; when the Black Chariot runs off to take a Soldier, Red's Chariot on file 2 takes the Chariot, and then the General steps out of the Horse's check.
entries.Giải chiếu bằng nước chiếu ngược (pháo 9: Get out of check with a counter-check (the Cannon on file 9 shifts to the central file), then the Chariot on file 2 takes Black's Cannon on file 8; when Black's Chariot on file 8 takes back, Red's Chariot on file 8 advances up file 8 and takes Black's Chariot on file 2. Red ends a Cannon up.
entries.Hai xe chồng liên tiếp ăn pháo, ăn xe (t: The two stacked Chariots take the Cannon and then the Chariot in turn (sacrificing both Chariots) to pull the Black General to file 6, then the Cannon drops to the back rank and checks with the Horse as its screen, and a Soldier gives checkmate.
entries.Không chiếu mà tạo lưới song mã: mã 7 ăn: No checks; build a two-Horse net instead: the Horse on file 7 takes an Advisor and covers two points around the General, an Elephant blocks the Black Cannon's line, and then the Horse on file 1 jumps in with checkmate.
entries.Không được M5.4 chiếu (mã tiến): đỏ cứu: Do not check with H5+4 (Horse forward): Red saves the Chariot and the game turns around.
entries.Không được P7.1: đỏ mất cơ hội ăn xe và: Do not play C7+1: Red misses the chance to win the Chariot and ends up worse.
entries.Không được Tg5-6: theo engine thế cờ trở: Do not play K5=6: according to the engine the game goes back to level.
entries.Không được Tg5.1 chạy tướng: thế cờ trở: Do not move the General with K5+1: the position becomes dangerous for Red.
entries.Không được V1.3 ăn mã trước: đen giữ xe: Do not take the Horse with E1+3 first: Black keeps the Chariot and Red is behind in material.
entries.Không được X2-3: đỏ mất cơ hội ăn xe và: Do not play R2=3: Red misses the chance to win the Chariot and ends up worse.
entries.Không được X2.6 tiến xe tấn công: đen ph: Do not attack with R2+6: Black counterattacks and Red gets checkmated.
entries.Không được X3-1 ăn pháo ở nước này: đen: Do not take the Cannon with R3=1 on this move: Black has a dangerous attack.
entries.Không được X7.5 chiếu tiếp: đỏ thoát và: Do not keep checking with R7+5: Red escapes and Black misses the chance to win the Horse.
entries.Không được X9-8 (ra xe): bỏ lỡ cơ hội ăn: Do not play R9=8 (developing the Chariot): Red misses the chance to win back the Chariot and ends up behind in material.
entries.Không được lui xe (X4/4): đỏ giữ được xe: Do not pull the Chariot back (R4-4): Red keeps the Chariot and Black is worse.
entries.Không được lui xe về che (X3/7): đỏ mất: Do not pull the Chariot back to block (R3-7): Red loses the whole advantage.
entries.Không được để mã ở lại đáy (ví dụ S6.5):: Do not leave the Horse on the back rank (for example A6+5): the Black General takes it and the endgame is level again.
entries.Kết hợp tốt mã đỏ và hai pháo đỏ để chiế: Combine Red's Soldier, Horse and two Cannons to checkmate in 4 moves, using a Soldier to eliminate Black's strong defender, the Horse.
entries.Lui xe không đủ sâu (ví dụ X2/2) thì đen: If the Chariot does not retreat far enough (for example R2-2), Black gets counterplay and the game is level.
entries.Lùi sĩ che chiếu (ô sĩ được tướng bảo vệ: Retreat the Advisor to block the check (the Advisor point is protected by the General). Red is a Horse up, and the Red Chariot and Cannon are both active deep in Black's half.
The central file is the battlefield for both sides. If Red does nothing, Black uses the Cannon and two Chariots to open the central file and attack the Red General on the second rank. In the main line the Red General is checked twice in a row, and each time it must get out of check with a capture that gives check. If Red only moves the General, Red is checkmated in 3 moves.
entries.Mã 1 lùi chiếu (chân mã đã thông). Tướng: The Horse on file 1 retreats with check (its leg is now free). The General cannot go back to file 4 or move up to the second rank (the Soldier on file 6 covers both points), and going to file 6 runs into its own Advisor, so it is checkmate.
entries.Mã 1 nhảy vào chiếu. Hai ô thoát của tướ: The Horse on file 1 jumps in with check. Both of the General's escape points are covered by the Horse on file 6, and no Black piece can take the Horse: checkmate with two Horses.
entries.Mã 1 nhảy xuống đáy chiếu tướng. Tướng đ: The Horse on file 1 jumps down to the back rank and checks the General. The Red General can only step to file 4 (or move up to the second rank).
entries.Mã 4 nhảy vào chiếu. Mã rời lộ 4 nên mặt: The Horse on file 4 jumps in with check. With the Horse off file 4, the Red General controls the back-rank point of file 6; the Black General cannot move, and Black must take the Horse with the Horse on file 9.
entries.Mã 4 ăn sĩ chiếu. Tướng không sang 6 và: The Horse on file 4 takes the Advisor with check. The General cannot go to file 6 or move up (the Horse on file 3 covers both points), so it must step to file 4.
entries.Mã 6 ăn mã 5 đen (đổi mã), sau đó mã 7 n: The Horse on file 6 takes Black's Horse on file 5 (trading Horses), then the Horse on file 7 jumps up to exactly the point the first Horse left and takes the Black Horse that just took back, and finally the Horse retreats to safety. Red ends a Horse up by getting the order right.
entries.Mã 6 ăn mã 5 đen. Đen ăn lại bằng mã 6 —: The Horse on file 6 takes Black's Horse on file 5. Black takes back with the Horse on file 6, which lands on the central point with nothing protecting it.
entries.Mã 7 lùi chiếu. Ô tầng 3 và ô đáy của lộ: The Horse on file 7 retreats with check. The third-rank point and the back-rank point of file 4 are both covered by the Horse on file 8, and the point beside the General is blocked by its own Black Horse: checkmate with two Horses.
entries.Mã 7 ăn pháo đầu: giải chiếu và lấy quân: The Horse on file 7 takes the central Cannon: it gets out of check and wins a piece. Red answers with the Chariot on file 2 taking Black's Chariot on file 8 down the file.
entries.Mã 7 ăn pháo: vừa giải chiếu vừa lấy lại: The Horse on file 7 takes the Cannon: out of check and winning back material. Red has 2 Horses against Black's 1 Horse.
entries.Mã 7 ăn sĩ chiếu. Tướng không về lộ 4 (p: The Horse on file 7 takes an Advisor with check. The General cannot go back to file 4 (the Cannon on file 6 covers it through the Horse screen) or go to file 6 (a Black Advisor is in the way), so it must move up and take the Cannon on file 5.
entries.Mã 8 nhảy vào chiếu. Tướng không sang 4: The Horse on file 8 jumps in with check. The General cannot go to file 4 (the Black Cannon is in the way) or file 6 (the Advisor is in the way), so it must move up to the second rank.
entries.Mã 8 ăn pháo chiếu. Tướng không sang 5 (: The Horse on file 8 takes the Cannon with check. The General cannot go to file 5 (the flying General rule); it can only retreat to the back rank or move up to the third rank.
entries.Mã 9 chiếu. Tướng không sang 5 (mặt tướn: The Horse on file 9 checks. The General cannot go to file 5 (the flying General rule) or move up to the second rank (the Horse on file 7 covers it): checkmate with two Horses.
entries.Mã 9 ăn pháo đen chiếu. Tướng đen không: The Horse on file 9 takes the Black Cannon with check. The Black General cannot move forward or to file 5, because the Soldier on file 5 covers both points, and no piece can take the Horse, so it is checkmate. The whole attack rests on a single Soldier locking the palace from the start.
entries.Mã 9 ăn tượng chiếu. Tướng không sang 5: The Horse on file 9 takes the Elephant with check. The General cannot go to file 5 (the flying General rule) and cannot stay on the third rank, so it must retreat to the second rank.
entries.Mã chiếu. Tướng không lui (tốt 3 khống c: Horse check. The General cannot retreat (the Soldier on file 3 covers it), cannot go to file 5 (the flying General rule), cannot leave the palace, and no Black piece can take the Horse, so it is checkmate.
entries.Mã lui về lộ 6 làm ngòi cho pháo 6 ở bờ: The Horse retreats to file 6 to act as the screen for the Cannon on file 6 on the riverbank, which checks up the file. The General cannot move forward (still in the Cannon's range) or to file 5 (the flying General rule), and Black has no piece left to block in between, so it is checkmate.
entries.Mã lui về lộ 6: rời khỏi hàng đáy để phá: The Horse retreats to file 6: it leaves the back rank so the Cannon on file 9 checks through the Black Advisor as a screen, and the Horse on file 6 also checks the General: a double check. The General cannot move up (the Soldier on file 4 covers it), cannot go to file 6 (the Black Chariot blocks it), and cannot go to file 4 (the Black Advisor blocks it), so it is checkmate.
The Horse retreats to take the last Black Chariot and checks again. Black has no Chariots left. The General can only go back to the back rank (taking the Cannon) or up to the third rank again.
entries.Mã lùi chiếu mở: rời lộ giữa để pháo 5 đ: The Horse retreats with a discovered check: it leaves the central file so Black's Cannon on file 5 checks the General through Red's Soldier on file 5 as a screen. Red must get out of check, so the Red Chariot deep in Black's half has no time to escape.
entries.Mã lùi chiếu. Tướng không sang 5 (mặt tư: The Horse retreats with check. The General cannot go to file 5 (the flying General rule) or retreat to the back rank (a Black Advisor is in the way), so it must move up to the third rank.
entries.Mã lùi lên tầng 2 chiếu tướng lần nữa, đ: The Horse retreats to the second rank and checks the General again while attacking Red's Cannon on file 6: a Horse fork of General and Cannon. Red must raise an Advisor to block the Horse's leg.
entries.Mã lùi về: rời hàng ngang để pháo lấy sĩ: The Horse retreats: it leaves the rank so the Cannon checks through the Advisor as a screen (discovered check), and the Horse lands on a point that attacks Black's Horse on file 5. Black must get out of check first.
entries.Mã lùi ăn xe đỏ. Đen đổi xe lấy xe và ăn: The Horse retreats and takes the Red Chariot. Black has traded Chariots and won the central Cannon as well: a Cannon up right out of the opening.
entries.Mã nhảy ra lộ 7 chiếu. Tướng không sang: The Horse jumps out to file 7 with check. The General cannot go to file 4 (the flying General rule), and cannot move up or go to file 6 (the Soldier on file 4 covers both points), so it is checkmate.
entries.Mã nhảy vào lộ 7 làm ngòi cho pháo đáy c: The Horse jumps to file 7 to act as a screen for the back-rank Cannon's check. The General has nowhere to go: file 4 is covered by the Cannon through the Horse screen, moving up is covered by the Soldier on file 4, and file 6 is blocked by the Black Chariot that just captured. Black's only option is to retreat the Advisor from file 5 to file 4 to put one more piece in the way (a Cannon with two screens cannot check).
entries.Mã rút về bờ sông. Theo engine đây là nư: The Horse retreats to the riverbank. According to the engine this is the only move that keeps the advantage; if the Horse stays, Black has a way to equalize.
entries.Mã rút về: tướng đen vừa lùi về đáy, đứn: The Horse pulls back: the Black General has just retreated to the back rank right next to the Horse, so a Horse that stays would be taken by the General. The Horse goes back to safety, and Red is a full Horse up.
entries.Mã sau ăn nốt xe 2 đen và chiếu. Đen đã: The rear Horse takes Black's last Chariot on file 2 with check. Black has no Chariots left; the General can only move up to the second rank or go back to file 5.
entries.Mã sau ăn pháo chặn. Đỏ lấy lại quân và: The rear Horse takes the blocking Cannon. Red wins back material, and the two Horses protect each other right next to the Black General.
entries.Mã sau ăn xe trước của đen và chiếu tướn: The rear Horse takes Black's front Chariot with check. Red wins back a strong piece and forces Black to react: Black must take the Horse with the Chariot on file 2 or take the back-rank Cannon with the General.
entries.Mã trước nhảy vào chiếu. Tướng không san: The front Horse jumps in with check. The General cannot go to file 5 or move up to the second rank (the Soldier on file 5 covers both points), and no Black piece can take the Horse, so it is checkmate.
entries.Mã ăn mã 5 đen. Đỏ hơn một mã, tốt 5 đỏ: The Horse takes Black's Horse on file 5. Red is a Horse up, and Red's Soldier on file 5 across the river is still intact.
The Horse takes a Black Horse for the second time. Red is a Horse up.
entries.Mã ăn mã ở đáy chiếu. Đen có hai lựa chọ: The Horse takes the Horse on the back rank with check. Black has two choices, retreating the General to the back rank to take the Soldier or stepping to file 5, and both lose.
entries.Mã ăn pháo 6 đỏ. Đen hơn một pháo, tàn c: The Horse takes Red's Cannon on file 6. Black is a Cannon up with a winning endgame.
entries.Mã ăn xe 7 chiếu. Tướng không về lộ 5 đư: The Horse takes the Chariot on file 7 with check. The General cannot go back to file 5 (the Horse has just left the central file, so the Generals would face each other), and the point in front holds a Red Cannon protected by the Soldier on file 4; Black must take the Horse with the Cannon on file 7. The Black Chariot, the piece that could have taken the Soldier on file 4, is gone.
entries.Mã đen vừa chặn lại chiếu tướng đỏ. Xe ă: The Black Horse that just blocked also checks the Red General. The Chariot takes that Horse: it gets out of check and keeps checking. Black must take the Chariot with the Cannon on file 1 (using the Horse on file 3 as its screen).
entries.Mọi nước của đen đều thua B4.1; nếu X4-5: Every Black move loses to P4+1; if R4=5 (the Chariot blocks the line between the Generals), P5+1 takes the Chariot with checkmate. Do not rush P4+1 right away: the Soldier is not protected yet, the General takes it, and the attack falls apart.
entries.Mọi nước của đen đều thua B7-6. Nếu mã n: Every Black move loses to P7=6. If the Horse jumps away to make an escape point, that point is still covered by the Soldier on file 6.
entries.Mọi nước của đen đều thua M1.3. Không đư: Every Black move loses to H1+3. Do not rush H1+3 before blocking the Cannon: the Black Cannon takes the Horse with the Soldier as its screen.
Every Black move loses to C9=4.
entries.Mọi nước của đen đều thua X2-3. Nếu vội: Every Black move loses to R2=3. If Red rushes R2=3 without this Cannon move, the Advisor on file 5 moves up to block (A5-6) and Red cannot mate.
entries.Mọi nước khác (ví dụ S5.4 che) đều để đe: Every other move (for example blocking with A5+4) lets Black keep attacking, and Red loses.
entries.Mọi nước đáp của đen đều thua M5.7. Nếu: Every Black reply loses to H5+7. If Black does not take the Cannon, H5+7 is a double check (the Cannon on file 5 checks through the Black Chariot as a screen plus the Horse check). If R5+4 takes the Cannon, H5+7 still mates as in the main line.
entries.Một nước mã êm để bắt pháo 5 đen; đen ăn: One quiet Horse move attacks Black's Cannon on file 5; Black takes a Soldier with check to escape, Red takes the Cannon with the Horse on file 7 (getting out of check and winning material at once), and then pulls the Horse back to safety: a piece up in the endgame.
entries.Một nước tượng êm để bắt mã 7 đen. Đen đ: One quiet Elephant move attacks Black's Horse on file 7. Black trades Chariots to counterattack, Red takes back the Chariot with check (the central Cannon uses an Advisor as its screen), and then the Elephant takes the Horse: a full Horse up.
entries.Nhìn về quân lực, bên đen đang hơn 1 phá: In material, Black is a Cannon up, has a Soldier across the river and an active Chariot, but the General is in danger. Red has an unopposed Cannon and a Horse working together; Red's other strong pieces have not been developed yet.
entries.Nhảy mã chiếu để mở đường cho xe 3 (chiế: Jump the Horse in with check to open the line for the Chariot on file 3 (check and attack on the Chariot at the same time), retreat the Chariot to take Black's Chariot on file 7, then keep retreating the Chariot to the back rank to block the Black Cannon's check.
entries.Nước then chốt: xe lui một mạch về đáy n: The key move: the Chariot retreats all the way to Red's own back rank to defend. The Red General is on the third rank and very exposed to a string of Black Chariot checks; with the Chariot on the back rank, the General and the Cannon on file 3 are safe.
entries.Nước êm then chốt: mã ăn tượng, không ch: The key quiet move: the Horse takes the Elephant, with no check, but threatens H5+7. Black has no check to win back the tempo, so nothing can stop the finishing blow.
entries.Nước êm then chốt: pháo bình vào lộ giữa: The key quiet move: the Cannon shifts to the central file and, with the Black Cannon as its screen, holds the central Advisor. That Advisor is pinned: if it leaves its point to block a check, the Red Cannon checks the General directly. Red threatens R2=3, taking the Elephant with checkmate, and Black has no check to win back the tempo.
entries.Nước êm then chốt: tốt 6 bình vào lộ 5,: The key quiet move: the Soldier on file 6 shifts to file 5, protecting the point in front of the General and controlling the back-rank point of file 5. It threatens checkmate with P4+1, and Black has no check to win back the tempo.
entries.Nước êm thứ hai: tượng 1 lên chặn đường: The second quiet move: the Elephant on file 1 moves up to block the Cannon's line. The Black Cannon now has two pieces in the way (the Red Elephant and the Black Soldier), so it cannot take the Horse when it jumps in. Black has run out of defenses.
entries.Nước êm: mã 4 lùi về, bắt pháo 5 đen. Đe: A quiet move: the Horse on file 4 retreats and attacks Black's Cannon on file 5. Black chooses to counterattack: the Cannon retreats to take the Soldier on file 5 with check.
entries.Nước êm: mã 7 nhảy lên đúng ô mã 6 vừa r: A quiet move: the Horse on file 7 jumps up to exactly the point the Horse on file 6 just left, attacking the Black Horse in the center again. According to the engine, Black cannot save the Horse.
entries.Nước êm: mã 7 ăn sĩ. Từ ô này mã khống c: A quiet move: the Horse on file 7 takes an Advisor. From this point the Horse covers both the back-rank point of file 5 and the second-rank point of file 6, the General's only two escape points. It threatens checkmate with H1+3.
entries.Nước êm: mã nhảy về ngay trước tướng đen: A quiet move: the Horse jumps back right in front of the Black General to act as a screen. It threatens C9=4 (the Cannon shifts to file 4 with the Horse as its screen) with checkmate, because the General cannot go to file 5 (the flying General rule) or retreat (it would still be on the Cannon's line).
entries.Nước êm: tượng 3 lên cánh phải, bắt mã 7: A quiet move: the Elephant on file 3 moves up on the right flank and attacks Black's Horse on file 7. Black chooses to counterattack by trading Chariots.
entries.Nước êm: tốt 5 tiến lên tầng 2, khống ch: A quiet move: the Soldier on file 5 advances to the second rank and controls the back-rank point of file 5. The Black General is locked in the corner, and Red threatens checkmate with P4+1.
entries.Nước êm: tốt 7 tiến xuống đáy, chuẩn bị: A quiet move: the Soldier on file 7 advances to the back rank, ready to shift in next to the General. The Black General is boxed in by its own Horse and Advisor with no escape; Red threatens checkmate with P7=6.
entries.Nếu B5-4 (tốt ăn pháo) thì B6.1 chiếu, P: If P5=4 (the Soldier takes the Cannon), P6+1 check, C6=4 takes the Soldier, +P=6 takes the Cannon with check, K4=5, H1-3 checkmate: the same pattern as the main line.
entries.Nếu M7.6 ăn tốt thì B4.1 chiếu hết. Mọi: If H7+6 takes a Soldier, P4+1 is checkmate. No other Black move stops the Soldier mate either.
entries.Nếu M7/5 thì S4.5 ăn tốt, đỏ vẫn hơn thế: If H7-5, A4+5 takes the Soldier and Red is still better. If +P+1 checks, then K6+1, and Red still takes the Advisor with R6+3 as in the main line.
entries.Nếu M8.6 chặn thì Mt.3 chiếu hết. Nếu M4: If H8+6 blocks, +H+3 is checkmate. If H4-6 blocks, +R+4 takes the Horse with checkmate. If H4+6 or C9=6 blocks, the front Chariot keeps taking the blocking piece and Red mates a few moves later.
If H8+6 blocks, R4+1 takes the Horse with checkmate.
entries.Nếu M8.6 thì Mt.3 chiếu hết; nếu M4/6 th: If H8+6, +H+3 is checkmate; if H4-6, +R+3 takes the Horse with checkmate; if H4+6, +R+1 takes the Horse with check and Red mates in 3 moves.
entries.Nếu M8.6 thì Xt.1 ăn mã chiếu và chiếu h: If H8+6, +R+1 takes the Horse with check and Red mates in 3 moves; if H4-6, +R+2 takes the Horse with checkmate.
entries.Nếu M9/7 che thì X2-3 ăn mã chiếu, V9/7: If H9-7 blocks, R2=3 takes the Horse with check, E9-7 takes the Chariot, C2+2 check, E7+9, P3+1 checkmate.
entries.Nếu P3-4 chặn thì X6.4 ăn pháo chiếu hết: If C3=4 blocks, R6+4 takes the Cannon with checkmate. If H3-4 blocks, H8-7 takes the Cannon with check, K4-1, and R6+2 takes the Horse with checkmate.
If C3=9 takes the Cannon, Red is only slightly better.
entries.Nếu P9-6 ăn mã thì X3/3 ăn xe; nếu Tg5-6: If C9=6 takes the Horse, R3-3 takes the Chariot; if K5=6, P3+1 takes an Elephant with check and Red is clearly ahead.
entries.Nếu S4.5 che thì X5-3 chiếu mở, Tg5-4, X: If A4+5 blocks, then R5=3 with a discovered check, K5=4, and R3-3 takes the Chariot, just like the main line.
entries.Nếu S4.5 che thì đỏ vẫn X5-7 chiếu mở rồ: If A4+5 blocks, Red still plays R5=7 with a discovered check and then R7-6 takes the Chariot, as in the main line. Do not check with R5=8: Red loses the initiative and is behind in material.
entries.Nếu S4/5 (sĩ ăn pháo 5) thì M7/6 chiếu h: If A4-5 (the Advisor takes the Cannon on file 5), H7-6 is checkmate: the Horse becomes the screen for the Cannon on file 6.
If A4-5 blocks, R2+5 is checkmate. If E3+5 blocks, R5+3 takes the Elephant with check, A4-5, R2+5 checkmate. If C6=5 blocks, R5+3 takes the Cannon with check, E3+5 takes the Chariot, R2+5 checkmate.
entries.Nếu S4/5 che thì X5.1 ăn sĩ chiếu, Tg5-4: If A4-5 blocks, R5+1 takes the Advisor with check, K5=4, R5=7 (the Chariot leaves the file and the Horse on file 4 checks) checkmate.
entries.Nếu S5.4 (lên sĩ che) thì P2/1 chiếu, đe: If A5+4 (an Advisor moves up to block), C2-1 checks, Black blocks with R6-1, and P3=4 takes the Chariot with checkmate. If R6=4 (the Chariot blocks), R5=7 takes the Chariot with check and Red mates a few moves later.
entries.Nếu S5.6 (sĩ ăn tốt) thì X4.6 ăn sĩ chiế: If A5+6 (the Advisor takes the Soldier), R4+6 takes the Advisor with check and Red mates in 4 moves. If K6-1 (the General retreats to take the Soldier on the back rank), P4+1 check, K6=5, R2=3 takes the Elephant with check, A5-6, R3=4 takes the Advisor with checkmate.
If A5-4 blocks, R9=6 takes the Advisor with checkmate.
entries.Nếu S6.5 che thì X3.6 ăn tượng chiếu hết: If A6+5 blocks, R3+6 takes the Elephant with checkmate at once.
entries.Nếu Tg4-5 hoặc P4-3 thì đỏ vẫn X2.8 ăn x: If K4=5 or C4=3, Red still takes the Chariot with R2+8.
entries.Nếu Tg4-5 thì M7/6 chiếu hết: tướng khôn: If K4=5, H7-6 is checkmate: the General cannot go back to file 4 (the Horse on file 8 covers it), cannot go to file 6 (the Soldier on file 3 covers it), and cannot move up (its own Black Horse is in the way).
entries.Nếu Tg4.1 (lên tầng 3) thì M8/6 vẫn chiế: If K4+1 (up to the third rank), H8-6 still mates: the Horse becomes the screen for the riverbank Cannon, the General cannot go to file 5 (the flying General rule), and stepping back keeps it in the Cannon's range.
entries.Nếu Tg4.1 thì X5-6 chiếu hết; nếu Tg4/1: If K4+1, R5=6 is checkmate; if K4-1, P4+1 takes the Chariot and Red mates in 3 moves.
entries.Nếu Tg5-6 không ăn tốt thì B3.1 chiếu hế: If K5=6 instead of taking the Soldier, P3+1 is checkmate: the General cannot go back to file 5 (the Soldier on file 5 covers it) or move up (its own Black Chariot is in the way).
entries.Nếu Tg5-6 ăn xe thì P2.5 chiếu (lấy mã l: If K5=6 takes the Chariot, C2+5 checks (with the Horse as its screen), K6+1, and R4+4 takes the Chariot with checkmate.
entries.Nếu Tg5.1 (tướng lên) thì P2.4 chiếu hết: If K5+1 (the General moves up), C2+4 is checkmate at once.
entries.Nếu Tg5.1 (ăn pháo 5) thì X1/1 ăn pháo c: If K5+1 (taking the Cannon on file 5), R1-1 takes the Cannon with check along the second rank, R8-3 blocks, R1=2 takes the Chariot with check, R7+1 blocks, and R2=3 takes the Chariot with checkmate.
entries.Nếu Tg6-5 chạy tướng thì X6-5 chiếu và đ: If the General moves with K6=5, R6=5 checks and Red wins the Chariot, with checkmate 2 moves later.
If K6=5, R2-1 mates along the second rank.
entries.Nếu Tg6-5 ăn pháo thì B6.1 ăn xe chiếu,: If K6=5 takes the Cannon, P6+1 takes the Chariot with check, the General is forced to take the Soldier (K5=4), and R4+1 mates along the back rank. The move P6+1 (the Soldier takes the Chariot at once) also gives a big advantage, but Black escapes with H5+3 and there is no checkmate.
entries.Nếu Tg6.1 (tướng ăn tốt) thì B2-3 chiếu,: If K6+1 (the General takes the Soldier), then P2=3 check, K6-1, P3+1 check, K6+1, H7-6 checkmate: the same pattern as the main line.
If R2=7 (not taking the Chariot), Red ends up worse.
entries.Nếu X6-4 chiếu thì M7/6 ăn xe có chiếu (: If R6=4 checks, H7-6 takes the Chariot with check (forking the General and the Chariot). If R6=2, Red mates in 3 moves; if R6+6 checks, then K6+1 and Red is still clearly ahead.
If R6-1 (the Chariot takes the Soldier), C3=5 is checkmate. If K5-1, C3+6 takes the Elephant with checkmate (the Cannon uses the Horse on file 4 as its screen). If K5+1, -P+1 takes the Chariot with check, K5=4, C2-2 checkmate.
entries.Nếu X6/3 ăn tốt thì P2-5 ăn pháo giữa ch: If R6-3 takes the Soldier, C2=5 takes the central Cannon with checkmate: Red's Cannon on file 5 is the screen, the General cannot retreat (the Cannon covers it), cannot go to file 4 (the flying General rule), and taking the Cannon on file 5 runs into the Horse on file 6.
entries.Nếu X7-6 chiếu thì X4/3 ăn xe; nếu X2-6: If R7=6 checks, R4-3 takes the Chariot; if R2=6 checks, R4-2 takes the Chariot. Red comes out ahead either way.
entries.Nếu X7.1 (xe ăn tốt, bỏ ngòi) thì Pt/1 (: If R7+1 (the Chariot takes the Soldier, removing the screen), then +C-1 (the Cannon leaves the back rank so the Chariot on file 1 checks), R7-1 blocks, and R1=3 takes the Chariot with checkmate.
If R7+1 blocks, R1=3 takes the Chariot with checkmate.
entries.Nếu X7.4 ăn pháo thì M2.3 ăn lại xe; nếu: If R7+4 takes the Cannon, H2+3 takes back the Chariot; if C7+5 takes the Cannon, C3+5 takes the Chariot. Black comes out ahead either way.
entries.Nếu X7/1 chiếu thì Tg4/1 trở về; nếu X7-: If R7-1 checks, K4-1 goes back; if R7=6 checks, the General simply takes the Chariot (K4-1).
entries.Nếu bỏ qua (ví dụ B7.1 ăn tốt) thì xe đe: If Red skips this (for example takes a Soldier with P7+1), the Black Chariot takes the Cannon and the game is level again.
entries.Nếu bỏ qua (ví dụ P5-2) thì đỏ cứu được: If Black skips this (for example C5=2), Red saves the Chariot and Black loses the advantage.
entries.Nếu không bắt mã nhanh thì quân xe đen s: If Red does not go after the Horse quickly, the Black Chariot gets active in time and the chance to win the Horse on file 4 is gone.
entries.Nếu không chiếu liên tục thì đen đang có: If Red does not check without a break, Black can checkmate with the Chariot on file 1 in 2 moves.
entries.Nếu không chiếu được trước thì đen sẽ ấn: If Red does not check first, Black pushes a Soldier forward with check (a Soldier locking the palace), which is very dangerous for Red.
entries.Nếu không có quân pháo 9 đen thì đỏ có c: Without Black's Cannon on file 9, Red would have checkmate in 2 moves. The key is to eliminate Black's important defender and win.
entries.Nếu không kịp tấn công trước mà chạy xe: If Red does not strike first and instead moves the Chariot away, Black neutralizes all the Horse's attacking routes and Red loses much of the advantage.
entries.Nếu không tấn công nhanh mà đen kéo xe v: If Red does not attack quickly and Black brings the Chariot back to defend, the strong attack down the center loses most of its force.
entries.Nếu không tấn công nhanh mà đen lên mã q: If Red does not attack quickly and Black gets the Horse to its defensive post, the dangerous attack is gone, and the Black Chariot on file 3 is very strong.
entries.Nếu không tấn công nhanh thì xe mã tốt đ: If Red does not attack quickly, Black's Chariot, Horse and Soldier up front can cause Red serious trouble.
entries.Nếu không tấn công sớm thì đen sẽ phòng: If Red does not attack early, Black defends with the Horse and Chariot and an early checkmate is no longer possible.
entries.Nếu không ăn mã ngay (ví dụ P1/2) thì th: If Red does not take the Horse at once (for example C1-2), the game becomes level again.
entries.Nếu không ăn pháo ngay (ví dụ P2-7) thì: If Black does not take the Cannon at once (for example C2=7), the game becomes level again.
entries.Nếu không ăn xe ngay (ví dụ P4-2) thì đỏ: If Red does not take the Chariot at once (for example C4=2), Red loses the advantage.
entries.Nếu lui xe (X3/3) thì thế cờ chỉ cân bằn: If Black pulls the Chariot back (R3-3), the game is only level.
entries.Nếu mã đen ăn xe (M3.4 hoặc M2.4) thì M8: If a Black Horse takes the Chariot (H3+4 or H2+4), H8-7 takes the Cannon with check and H9+8 mates. If C3=4 blocks, R6+6 takes the Cannon with checkmate. If H3-4 blocks, H8-7 takes the Cannon with check, K4-1, and R6+4 takes the Horse with checkmate.
entries.Nếu sau đó đen P9-5 ăn tốt chiếu thì X3-: If Black then plays C9=5 taking a Soldier with check, R3=5 takes the Cannon at once.
If Red grabs a Soldier (C7=1), the Black Horse escapes.
entries.Nếu đen B4-5 hoặc B5.1 ăn tốt thì đỏ còn: If Black takes a Soldier with P4=5 or P5+1, Red's advantage is even bigger.
entries.Nếu đen B6-5 ăn tốt thì X2-5, đỏ vẫn hơn: If Black takes a Soldier with P6=5, then R2=5 and Red is still ahead.
entries.Nếu đen B9.1 hoặc Tg5-6 thì V1.3 ăn mã n: If Black plays P9+1 or K5=6, E1+3 takes the Horse at once.
entries.Nếu đen M6.5 ăn pháo thì V7.5 ăn mã, đỏ: If Black takes a Cannon with H6+5, E7+5 takes the Horse and Red is better; if H6+7, H5-4 checks and Red wins the Chariot.
entries.Nếu đen P1/1 thay vì chiếu thì đỏ vẫn P5: If Black plays C1-1 instead of checking, Red still plays C5=7 and keeps the whole extra Chariot.
entries.Nếu đen P2-6 (cứu pháo) thì X8-4 ăn mã;: If Black plays C2=6 (saving the Cannon), R8=4 takes the Horse; if H6+4, R8-2 takes the Cannon and Red is clearly ahead.
entries.Nếu đen P2/7 thì M3.1 ăn xe; nếu M4.3 ch: If Black plays C2-7, H3+1 takes the Chariot; if H4+3 checks, then K5=6, and when the Black Chariot runs off to take a Soldier, R2=1 takes the Chariot as in the main line.
entries.Nếu đen P5-2 (bỏ ngòi) thì P7.4 ăn tốt,: If Black plays C5=2 (removing the screen), C7+4 takes a Soldier and Red keeps a good position.
entries.Nếu đen S5.4 hoặc S5/6 (bỏ ngòi) thì P5/: If Black plays A5+4 or A5-6 (removing the screen), C5-3 takes a Soldier with check and then R3-3 takes the Chariot.
entries.Nếu đen S5.4 thì M6.5 ăn pháo chiếu, đỏ: If Black plays A5+4, H6+5 takes the Cannon with check and Red is clearly ahead. If H7+6 checks, then K5+1, and Red still wins the Cannon.
entries.Nếu đen X2.5 hoặc X8.5 thay vì ăn xe thì: If Black plays R2+5 or R8+5 instead of taking the Chariot, Red is even further ahead. Red's other moves (R2+1, or taking Black's Chariot on file 2 right away) do not keep the advantage.
entries.Nếu đen X7/6 (xe về che) thì X2-3 ăn xe: If Black plays R7-6 (the Chariot comes back to block), R2=3 takes the Chariot with check and Red mates a few moves later.
entries.Nếu đen X9/1 ăn tốt thì X3-5 ăn tượng, đ: If Black takes a Soldier with R9-1, R3=5 takes the Elephant and Red is clearly ahead.
entries.Nếu đen che bằng tượng (V7.5 hoặc V3.5): If Black blocks with an Elephant (E7+5 or E3+5), Red plays R2-5 to take the Chariot first and ends even further ahead.
entries.Nếu đen chạy pháo giữa sang lộ khác (P5-: If Black moves the central Cannon to another file (C5=4, C5=3 or C5=2) to remove the screen, H6-5 checks, the Black Cannon has to come back to file 5 to block, and H5+7 is checkmate.
entries.Nếu đen chạy tượng (V3.5 hoặc V3.1) thay: If Black moves the Elephant (E3+5 or E3+1) instead of taking the Cannon, H9-7 still mates.
entries.Nếu đen chậm, mã 2 đỏ sẽ về phòng thủ và: If Black is slow, Red's Horse on file 2 comes back to defend, the Red General is safe and the game is level. This is a typical Horse fork in the endgame.
entries.Nếu đen chậm, đỏ P7.6 ăn pháo 3 (lấy xe: If Black is slow, Red plays C7+6 to take the Cannon on file 3 (with the Chariot on file 7 as the screen) and takes over. This is the moment to strike.
entries.Nếu đen chậm, đỏ X3-6 chiếu rồi ăn tốt v: If Black is slow, Red checks with R3=6, takes a Soldier, and the game is level. This exercise teaches the technique of using the Chariot to pick off defenders with a string of checks.
entries.Nếu đen dùng sĩ ăn xe (S5/6) thì M9.7 ch: If Black takes the Chariot with the Advisor (A5-6), H9+7 is checkmate at once: the Cannon on file 9 checks with the Horse as a screen, the General cannot step to file 4 (the Cannon covers it), and moving up is covered by the Soldier on file 4. The move P4+1 (the Soldier takes the Cannon with check) also gets out of check and still keeps the better game, but it does not mate quickly; to finish the game you need R3=4.
entries.Nếu đen dùng tướng ăn pháo đáy (Tg4/1) t: If Black takes the back-rank Cannon with the General (K4-1), then P5=6: the Soldier becomes the screen for the riverbank Cannon's check; Black must shift the Chariot from file 2 to file 4 to block, and P6+1 takes the Chariot with checkmate (a Soldier–Cannon double check).
entries.Nếu đen dùng xe ăn pháo thì đỏ ăn lại và: If Black takes a Cannon with the Chariot, Red takes back and is ahead in material.
entries.Nếu đen dùng xe ăn tốt (X1-3) thì Pt.1 v: If Black takes the Soldier with the Chariot (R1=3), +C+1 still checks through the Chariot as a screen, and then H9-7 mates in the same way.
entries.Nếu đen không ăn lại mà B3.1 ăn tốt thì: If Black does not take back but plays P3+1 to take a Soldier, then R8=7 and Red is clearly ahead.
entries.Nếu đen không ăn mã mà X3-7 hoặc X3-6 th: If Black does not take the Horse but plays R3=7 or R3=6, Red still retreats the Chariot with a discovered check and wins the Chariot, which is even better. K5=4 only keeps the balance.
entries.Nếu đen không ăn mã ngay (ví dụ Tg4-5) t: If Black does not take the Horse at once (for example K4=5), the advantage is gone.
entries.Nếu đen không ăn pháo (M5.7 ăn tốt hoặc: If Black does not take the Cannon (H5+7 taking a Soldier, or R6+5), Red is even further ahead.
entries.Nếu đen không ăn xe (ví dụ lui xe 8) thì: If Black does not take the Chariot (for example pulls back the Chariot on file 8), the Red Cannon takes a Horse and Red is clearly ahead.
entries.Nếu đỏ P3-6 hoặc B3-4 thì đen vẫn X5.2 ă: If Red plays C3=6 or P3=4, Black still takes the Horse with check by R5+2.
entries.Nếu đỏ S5/6 chặn thì đen X2-4 ăn sĩ chiế: If Red blocks with A5-6, Black takes the Advisor with check by R2=4 and mates a few moves later.
entries.Nếu đỏ X4-1 thì P2-9 ăn xe; nếu M7/5 (ph: If Red plays R4=1, C2=9 takes the Chariot; if Red counterattacks with H7-5, P5+1 takes the Horse and Black still wins the Chariot.
entries.Nếu đỏ X9-6 ăn xe thì đen Pt.7 (pháo trư: If Red takes the Chariot with R9=6, Black mates at once with +C+7 (the front Cannon drops to the back rank and takes the Elephant). Red's other replies (E7+9, H5+6) leave Black even further ahead.
entries.Nếu đỏ chậm một nhịp, đen X5.5 ăn pháo 5: If Red loses one tempo, Black plays R5+5 to take the Cannon on file 5 and then brings both Cannons and the Horse together to checkmate the Red General (about 7 moves according to the engine). This is a race: whoever strikes first wins.
entries.Nếu đỏ chậm, mã 5 đen sẽ tham gia tấn cô: If Red is slow, Black's Horse on file 5 joins the attack (H5+7 and then takes an Elephant) and the game becomes level. Taking the Elephant with the Horse (H3-5) also only leads to equality.
entries.Nếu đỏ chậm, mã 7 đen nhảy vào chiếu (M7: If Red is slow, Black's Horse on file 7 jumps in with check (H7+5) and then takes a Red Horse, and Red loses the endgame. This exercise asks you to calculate that losing a Soldier to a check still works out in Red's favor.
entries.Nếu đỏ chậm, mã đen nhảy ra (M7.8) và ph: If Red is slow, the Black Horse jumps out (H7+8) and works with the Chariot, and the game becomes level. If Red takes the Horse at once without checking first, Black has enough counterplay to hold the balance (according to the engine).
entries.Nếu đỏ chậm, tốt 6 đen tiến tiếp và mã đ: If Red is slow, Black's Soldier on file 6 advances further and the Black Horse joins in an attack on the Red General on the second rank; according to the engine, Black takes over. The pair of the Chariot on file 6 and the Horse on file 7 (the Chariot blocking the Horse's leg) is a discovered-check weapon waiting to be fired.
entries.Nếu đỏ chậm, đen P8-6 rồi xe chiếu và ăn: If Red is slow, Black plays C8=6, then checks with the Chariot and takes the Soldier on file 5; the game becomes level or tilts toward Black. The hard part is the second move: right after winning material you must pull back to defend.
entries.Nếu đỏ chậm, đen S6.5 rồi dùng pháo ăn t: If Red is slow, Black plays A6+5, then takes Soldiers with the Cannons and trades a Black Horse for a Red Horse, and Black is slightly better. Grabbing a Soldier with C7=1 at any point in this exercise only keeps the balance.
entries.Nếu đỏ chậm, đen đưa tướng sang lộ 6 rồi: If Red is slow, Black moves the General to file 6 and then trades Chariots with R6=5; Red loses the central Cannon and the game becomes level. The move C5=8 also only keeps the balance.
entries.Nếu đỏ không ăn lại pháo thì đen hơn một: If Red does not take back the Cannon, Black is a Cannon up.
entries.Nếu đỏ không ăn pháo mà M7/5 thì B5.1 ăn: If Red does not take the Cannon but plays H7-5, P5+1 takes the Horse.
entries.Nếu đỏ không ăn xe (ví dụ X2.4 hoặc X2-1: If Red does not take the Chariot (for example R2+4 or R2=1), Black keeps the extra material easily.
entries.Nếu đỏ đi chậm, đen P2.1 chiếu và ba quâ: If Red is slow, Black checks with C2+1 and the three Black pieces in Red's half start winning material; Red is behind and will lose. Every Red move must be a check so Black has no time.
entries.Nếu đỏ đi ngay B8-7 chiếu thì đen P3/4:: If Red checks with P8=7 right away, Black plays C3-4: the Cannon on file 3 uses a Black Soldier as a screen to take the Soldier, the attack dies out, and Red loses for lack of material. That is why the Horse must be sacrificed first.
Taking the Advisor with C4+6 only keeps the balance.
entries.Phá lá chắn trước mặt tướng đen: tốt ăn: Break the shield in front of the Black General: a Soldier takes the Chariot with check, the Chariot on file 4 takes a Cannon to get out of check while checking (a Chariot sacrifice), the Horse takes the Horse with check to pull the General back to the back rank, the Cannon drops to the back rank with check, and the Chariot on file 2 takes the Elephant with checkmate.
entries.Pháo 1 tiến lên hàng của tướng đen, lấy: The Cannon on file 1 advances to the Black General's rank and checks with the Horse on file 3 as its screen. The point to the General's right is also on the Cannon's line; the two Black Horses cannot take the Horse on file 3 because their own Advisors block their legs, so it is checkmate.
entries.Pháo 2 bình sang lộ 6 chiếu (lấy pháo đe: The Cannon on file 2 shifts to file 6 with check (using the Black Cannon as its screen) and opens file 2 for the Red Chariot; when Black moves the Cannon to remove the screen, the Chariot on file 2 advances and takes Black's Chariot on file 8. Then the Red General must move up to avoid the counter-check.
entries.Pháo 2 bình sang lộ 6 chiếu, đồng thời r: The Cannon on file 2 shifts to file 6 with check, and by leaving file 2 it lets Red's Chariot on file 2 look straight at Black's Chariot on file 8. Black chooses to move the Cannon away to remove the screen.
entries.Pháo 2 bình ăn pháo giữa chiếu (lấy tượn: The Cannon on file 2 shifts across and takes the central Cannon with check (with the Elephant as its screen). Black must take the Cannon with the Chariot, and the Black Chariot lands on file 5, becoming the screen for the Red Cannon below.
entries.Pháo 2 xuống đáy, lấy mã 3 làm ngòi chiế: The Cannon on file 2 drops to the back rank and checks with the Horse on file 3 as its screen. The General cannot go back to file 5 (still on the Cannon's line), so it must move up to the second rank.
entries.Pháo 3 bình vào lộ giữa, lấy tốt 5 làm n: The Cannon on file 3 shifts to the central file and checks with the Soldier on file 5 as its screen. The General cannot move (the file 4 point is covered by the Horse on file 4, the back-rank point is also on the Cannon's line, and the file 6 point is covered by the Soldier on file 4). Black's Horse on file 4 was removed on the first move, so Black can only block with an Elephant.
entries.Pháo 3 lui, lấy tượng đen làm ngòi ăn mã: The Cannon on file 3 retreats, using the Black Elephant as a screen to take Black's Horse on file 7, which sits deep in Red's half.
entries.Pháo 3 tiến xuống đáy sân đen, lấy sĩ là: The Cannon on file 3 advances to Black's back rank and checks with an Advisor as its screen, winning a tempo to steady the position. Red is a Cannon up with a winning endgame.
entries.Pháo 4 bình ăn xe (lấy tốt 5 đen làm ngò: The Cannon on file 4 shifts across and takes the Chariot (with Black's Soldier on file 5 as its screen), checking up file 4. Black can only take the Cannon with the Soldier on file 5.
entries.Pháo 4 bình ăn xe, lấy chính tướng đen l: The Cannon on file 4 shifts across and takes the Chariot, using the Black General itself as the screen. Red is a full Chariot up.
entries.Pháo 4 tiến ăn pháo 6 đỏ (mã 4 đen làm n: The Cannon on file 4 advances and takes Red's Cannon on file 6 (Black's Horse on file 4 is the screen). Red takes back with the Advisor on file 5, so the Advisor leaves the middle of the palace and file 5 from the Red Horse down to the Red General becomes empty.
entries.Pháo 4 tiến ăn tốt, lấy sĩ 6 làm ngòi ch: The Cannon on file 4 advances to take a Soldier, checking with the Advisor on file 6 as its screen. Black must take the Cannon with the Chariot on file 1, and the Chariot leaves file 1 and no longer aims at Red's Chariot on file 9.
entries.Pháo 5 bình sang lộ 3, tạo pháo chồng vớ: The Cannon on file 5 shifts to file 3, stacking with the Cannon on file 3 at home: the rear Cannon uses the front Cannon as a screen to attack Black's Chariot on file 7. Black must move the Chariot.
entries.Pháo 5 bình sang lộ 3, tạo pháo chồng: p: The Cannon on file 5 shifts to file 3 to stack the Cannons: the rear Cannon uses the front Cannon as its screen to attack Red's Chariot on file 7. Red must move the Chariot.
entries.Pháo 5 bình sang lộ 4 tạo pháo chồng chi: Shift the Cannon on file 5 to file 4 to stack the Cannons and check (the front Cannon is the screen), forcing the Black Chariot to block; then the front Cannon shifts to file 1 with another check (the Black Chariot is the screen) while aiming at Black's Cannon on file 9. When the Black Chariot moves out of the way, the Cannon retreats and takes the Cannon.
entries.Pháo 5 bình sang lộ 4, tạo pháo chồng: l: The Cannon on file 5 shifts to file 4 to stack the Cannons: it checks the General with the Cannon on file 4 as its screen. Black must put the Chariot between the two Cannons to block.
entries.Pháo 5 bình sang lộ 7 chặn chân mã, hóa: The Cannon on file 5 shifts to file 7 to block the Horse's leg, stopping the check without moving the General. Red is a full Chariot up; Black has a few Cannon checks left, but they are no longer dangerous.
entries.Pháo 5 lui về ăn pháo đen trong cung đỏ,: The Cannon on file 5 retreats to take the Black Cannon in Red's palace, and at the same time checks the General with Black's central Cannon as its screen. One move removes Black's mating threat and keeps the attack going. Black must block with an Elephant.
entries.Pháo 5 tiến ăn sĩ (lấy tượng 5 đen làm n: The Cannon on file 5 advances to take an Advisor (with Black's Elephant on file 5 as its screen), wrecking Black's palace and threatening the Black General directly. Black chooses to use checks to win back the tempo.
entries.Pháo 5 ăn lại xe đen (lấy pháo đen làm n: The Cannon on file 5 takes back the Black Chariot (with the Black Cannon as its screen) and checks the General through an Advisor as a screen. Black must get out of check and cannot save the Horse.
entries.Pháo 5 đỏ đang bị xe 2 đen bắt. Nếu đỏ c: Red's Cannon on file 5 is being attacked by Black's Chariot on file 2. If Red is slow, Black takes the Cannon and takes over. Retreating the Cannon (C5-1) only keeps the balance.
entries.Pháo 6 lui ăn tốt, lấy tốt 6 làm ngòi ch: The Cannon on file 6 retreats to take a Soldier, checking up file 4 with the Soldier on file 6 as its screen. Black must take the Cannon: with the Chariot on file 4 (the Chariot is lured right onto the General's file) or with the Soldier on file 5.
entries.Pháo 7 bình sang lộ 6, lấy mã làm ngòi c: The Cannon on file 7 shifts to file 6 and checks up the file with the Horse as its screen. The General cannot move forward (it stays on the Cannon's line) or go back to file 5 (the Horse covers it), and Black has no piece that can take the screen, so it is checkmate.
entries.Pháo 7 bình sang lộ 6, lấy sĩ đen làm ng: The Cannon on file 7 shifts to file 6 and checks with a Black Advisor as its screen. The General must go back to file 5.
entries.Pháo 7 đỏ đang bị xe 2 đen bắt. Nếu đỏ c: Red's Cannon on file 7 is being attacked by Black's Chariot on file 2. If Red moves the Cannon away passively (for example C7=6), the Black Chariot and Horse keep harassing the left flank and Black takes the initiative.
The Cannon on file 8 drops to the back rank and checks with the Horse as its screen. The General cannot move up (the Horse covers it) or go to file 5 (the Cannon covers it through the Horse screen). Black can only pull the Elephant on file 5 back to block.
entries.Pháo 9 bình sang lộ 4, lấy mã làm ngòi c: The Cannon on file 9 shifts to file 4 and checks with the Horse as its screen. The General cannot go to file 5 (the flying General rule) or retreat (it stays on the Cannon's line), and no piece can block or take the Horse, so it is checkmate.
entries.Pháo 9 bình vào lộ giữa: vừa chặn đường: The Cannon on file 9 shifts to the central file: it blocks the Black Cannon's check and, with Black's Cannon on file 5 as its screen, gives a counter-check to the Black General. Black must raise an Advisor to block.
entries.Pháo bình ăn xe (sĩ 5 vẫn là ngòi). Đỏ ă: The Cannon shifts and takes the Chariot (the Advisor on file 5 is still the screen). Red takes back the Cannon with the Horse, giving check.
entries.Pháo lui chiếu theo hàng ngang để đẩy sĩ: Retreat the Cannon with a check along the rank to drive the central Advisor away, take the Horse with the Chariot, then retreat an Advisor to block the Black Chariot's counter-check: a full Horse up in the endgame.
entries.Pháo lui một bước, lấy mã 3 làm ngòi chi: The Cannon retreats one point and checks the General along the rank, using the Horse on file 3 as its screen. Black must block with an Advisor or move the General.
entries.Pháo lui một bước, lấy mã 7 làm ngòi chi: The Cannon retreats one point and checks the General along the rank, using the Horse on file 7 as its screen. Black must block with the Cannon on file 4, and the Black Cannon lands on a point the rear Horse can take.
entries.Pháo lui một bước, lấy sĩ 5 đen làm ngòi: The Cannon retreats one point and checks the General along the rank with Black's Advisor on file 5 as its screen. Black must remove the screen (the Advisor leaves the center of the palace) or move the General; Black's palace becomes more exposed.
entries.Pháo lui về hàng của tướng, lấy mã làm n: Retreat the Cannon to the General's rank and check with the Horse as the screen; Black raises an Advisor to block. Then the Horse leaves the rank for a discovered Cannon check (the Advisor is the screen), and with that tempo the Horse jumps back to take Black's Horse on file 5.
entries.Pháo lui về tầng 2, lấy sĩ 5 làm ngòi bắ: The Cannon retreats to the second rank and, with the Advisor on file 5 as its screen, attacks Red's Chariot on file 4. The Red Chariot has no escape: moving up to the back rank, the Black General takes it; moving down, the Advisor on file 6 is in the way; moving sideways, it stays on the Cannon's line.
entries.Pháo lui ăn pháo 6 đen, lấy tốt 4 làm ng: The Cannon retreats to take Black's Cannon on file 6, checking with the Soldier on file 4 as its screen. The Black Cannon on the riverbank could have used that Soldier as a screen to take it when it advanced to check; now that defender is gone. Black must take the Cannon with the Horse on file 4.
entries.Pháo lui ăn pháo 9 đen, xóa luôn mối đe: The Cannon retreats and takes Black's Cannon on file 9, which also removes the mating threat. Red is a Cannon up.
entries.Pháo lui ăn tốt chiếu để dụ xe đen vào l: The Cannon retreats to take a Soldier with check to lure the Black Chariot onto file 4, the second Cannon takes the Chariot with check, then the two Soldiers take turns checking (a Soldier sacrifice, then a Soldier takes a Cannon) to push the General to file 5, and finally the Horse on file 1 retreats with checkmate.
entries.Pháo sau tiến ăn mã (pháo trước làm ngòi: The rear Cannon advances to take the Horse (the front Cannon is the screen) and, with Black's Chariot on file 7 as its screen, checks the General. Black must take the Cannon with the Chariot on file 7 or move the Chariot to remove the screen.
entries.Pháo sau ăn mã chiếu (pháo trước làm ngò: The rear Cannon takes the Horse with check (the front Cannon is the screen), the Chariot on file 1 takes the Chariot with check, the Chariot goes on to take the Elephant (a Chariot sacrifice) to pull a Black Horse back to the back rank as a screen, then the front Cannon drops to the back rank with check and the Soldier on file 3 gives checkmate: Chariot, two Cannons and a Soldier working together.
entries.Pháo trước bình sang lộ 1 chiếu tiếp (xe: The front Cannon shifts to file 1 and checks again (the Black Chariot is the screen), and from file 1 it also aims at Black's Cannon on file 9 through Red's Soldier on file 1 as a screen. Black has to move the Chariot off the file to remove the screen.
entries.Pháo trước tiến ăn xe, lấy mã 7 đen làm: The front Cannon advances and takes the Chariot, using Black's Horse on file 7 as its screen. Result: Chariots traded and a Cannon won on top. Red is a full Cannon up.
entries.Pháo trước xuống đáy, lấy mã đen làm ngò: The front Cannon drops to the back rank and checks with the Black Horse as its screen. The General cannot move: the file 6 point and the file 4 point are both on the Cannon's line, and the second-rank point is covered by the Horse on file 7. Black can only jump the Horse away to remove the screen.
entries.Pháo trước xuống đáy, lấy tượng đen làm: The front Cannon drops to the back rank and checks with the Black Elephant as its screen. The General still has no free point (the Soldier on file 5 covers them), so Black can only take the Cannon with the Chariot on file 1 or move the Elephant to remove the screen.
entries.Pháo đen vừa che lại chiếu tướng đỏ (xe: The Black Cannon that just blocked also checks the Red General (with Red's Chariot on file 5 as its screen). The Chariot advances and takes the Cannon: out of check, and checking the Black General (a Chariot sacrifice). Black can only take the Chariot with the Elephant on file 3 or block with an Advisor.
entries.S6.5 (lên sĩ che) chỉ giữ thế cân bằng t: According to the engine, A6+5 (raising an Advisor to block) only keeps the balance.
entries.Sau 2 nước nữa sẽ chiếu tướng bắt xe đượ: Two more moves and Red checks the General while winning the Chariot.
entries.Sau 3 nước sẽ bắt được quân mạnh của đen: In 3 moves Red wins one of Black's strong pieces (the Black Chariot).
entries.Sau 4 nước sẽ ăn được tốt đen và chiếu h: In 4 moves Red wins the Black Soldier and delivers checkmate (using the flying General rule).
entries.Sau P2.1 chiếu của đen, đỏ lui tượng che: After Black's C2+1 check, retreating the Elephant to block (E9-7) is safe. Do not play R7=8 (skipping the capture): Black counterattacks and Red loses material.
entries.Sau vài nước phối hợp thì sẽ bằng quân v: After a few coordinated moves Red wins back the material and has the stronger attack.
entries.Sĩ 5 ăn mã giải chiếu. Đỏ đổi pháo lấy m: The Advisor on file 5 takes the Horse to get out of check. Red has traded a Cannon for a Horse but has also won the Cannon on file 2: a Cannon up.
K5=6 (moving the General) only keeps the balance.
entries.Thí liền hai tốt để kéo tướng đen lên rồ: Sacrifice two Soldiers in a row to pull the Black General up and then push it back, using that tempo for the Cannon on file 5 to retreat and take a Black Cannon with check (defending and attacking at once); trade a Cannon for Black's central Cannon to pull a Black Chariot onto file 5 as a screen; then the Horse makes a quiet move and the game ends with a Horse check (or a Cannon–Horse double check) in 6 moves.
entries.Thí liền hai xe để phá tan cung đen (ăn: Sacrifice both Chariots in a row to wreck Black's palace (taking the Horse and the Advisor), then use the Soldiers to pull the General to file 6 and push it back to file 5, shift the Cannon to the central file, and mate with a Soldier.
entries.Thí mã 4 để dụ xe 3 đen về hàng mà xe đỏ: Sacrifice the Horse on file 4 to lure Black's Chariot on file 3 onto a rank the Red Chariot can attack, then retreat the Chariot on file 6 off the Horse's leg: the Horse on file 7 gives a discovered check while the Chariot attacks the Black Chariot. Black must get out of check and loses the Chariot.
entries.Thí mã chiếu (mã 5 nhảy vào lộ 7, chiếu: Sacrifice the Horse with check (the Horse on file 5 jumps to file 7 and checks the General). The Black General cannot move because the Soldier on file 5 covers both points, so Black must take the Horse with the Cannon on file 3. The purpose is to lure that Cannon onto this point: from there it has no screen to guard the back-rank point on file 7, and this same point is where the Horse on file 9 will jump in to give checkmate.
entries.Thí mã chiếu. Mã rời lộ 3 nên xe 3 đỏ nh: Sacrifice the Horse with check. The Horse leaves file 3, so Red's Chariot on file 3 looks straight down at Black's Chariot on file 7; Black is in check and has no time to save the Chariot.
entries.Thí mã để kéo pháo 3 đen rời vị trí bảo: Sacrifice a Horse to pull Black's Cannon on file 3 away from guarding the back-rank point on file 7; then the Soldier on file 8 shifts in with check, the Red Cannon drops to the back rank with check, and the Horse on file 9 ends the game in 4 moves.
entries.Thí mã để mở mặt tướng và kéo mã 9 đen v: Sacrifice the Horse to open the line between the Generals and pull Black's Horse on file 9 back, play one quiet Cannon move that pins the central Advisor, then the Chariot on file 2 takes the Elephant and mates along the back rank.
entries.Thí mã: mã 4 nhảy lên ô nằm trên đường x: Horse sacrifice: the Horse on file 4 jumps onto a point on the line of Black's Chariot on file 3. Black takes the Horse, and the Black Chariot lands on a rank that Red's Chariot on file 6 can attack after retreating.
entries.Thí pháo 7 xuống đáy chiếu (tượng đen bu: Sacrifice the Cannon on file 7 with a check on the back rank (the Black Elephant is forced to take it) to open the rank for Red's Chariot on file 2 to take Black's Chariot on file 2; then use the Chariot to block the Horse's leg and neutralize the counter-check.
entries.Thí pháo ăn tốt chiếu để kéo xe 1 đen rờ: Sacrifice the Cannon to take a Soldier with check and pull Black's Chariot on file 1 off its file (rescuing the Chariot on file 9), push the General back to the back rank with a Soldier check, then the Chariot on file 9 drops to the back rank with check and takes the blocking Chariot, then the blocking Advisor, and mates.
entries.Thí pháo: pháo 7 tiến xuống đáy, lấy sĩ: Cannon sacrifice: the Cannon on file 7 drops to the back rank and checks through the Advisor on file 4 as its screen. The General cannot step aside (on file 6 it is still on the Cannon's line), so Black must take the Cannon with the Elephant on file 5. Red's second rank is now open.
entries.Thí tốt chiếu. Tướng không lên được (tốt: Sacrifice a Soldier with check. The General cannot move up (the Soldier on file 6 covers it), so it must take the Soldier and step onto file 6, where Red's Soldier on file 4 and Cannon on file 4 are waiting.
entries.Thí tốt chiếu. Tướng không sang 5 được (: Sacrifice the Soldier with check. The General cannot go to file 5 (the flying General rule) or back down to the back rank (the riverbank Cannon covers that point, using this very Soldier as its screen), so it must take the Soldier and move up to the third rank, a very bad point for the General.
entries.Thí tốt chiếu. Tốt được mã 7 bảo vệ nên: Sacrifice a Soldier with check. The Soldier is protected by the Horse on file 7, so the General cannot take it; all the other points are blocked by Black's own pieces. Black can only take the Soldier with the Cannon on file 6 (using the General as its screen), and the Cannon on file 6 leaves the General's rank.
entries.Thí tốt chiếu. Tốt được tốt 5 bảo vệ nên: Sacrifice a Soldier with check. The Soldier is protected by the Soldier on file 5, so the General cannot take it, and it cannot go to file 5 (the Soldier on file 5 covers it); Black must take the Soldier with the Cannon on file 6 (using the Soldier on file 5 as its screen). The Black Cannon leaves the point that was blocking the leg of the Horse on file 1.
entries.Thí tốt chiếu. Đen có hai lựa chọn: tướn: Sacrifice a Soldier with check. Black has two choices: the General takes the Soldier and steps to file 4, or moves up to take the Cannon on file 5.
entries.Thí tốt chiếu. Đen phải ăn tốt bằng xe h: Sacrifice the Soldier with check. Black must take it with the Chariot or the General. If the Chariot takes, it leaves the riverbank, loses the chance to take the Red Chariot on the back rank, and opens file 4 straight up for the Red Chariot.
entries.Thí tốt chiếu: tốt 6 bình vào lộ giữa ch: Soldier sacrifice with check: the Soldier on file 6 shifts to the central file and checks the General. The purpose is to pull the Black General up to the second rank, right above Red's Cannon on file 5.
entries.Thí tốt kéo tướng sang lộ 6, rồi lần lượ: Sacrifice a Soldier to pull the General to file 6, then take a Chariot with the Horse and a Cannon with the Cannon (both with check) to remove the defenders of file 6, and finally a quiet Soldier move builds the net and a Soldier gives checkmate.
entries.Thí tốt để kéo xe đen rời bờ sông (hóa g: Sacrifice a Soldier to pull the Black Chariot off the riverbank (stopping the mating threat and opening file 4 for the Red Chariot), sacrifice the Chariot to trade Chariots, then use the Soldier on file 2 to herd the General up and down and finish with a Horse mate, all built on the flying General rule locking file 5.
entries.Thí xe chiếu sát tướng. Tướng không lên: Sacrifice the Chariot with a check right next to the General. The General cannot move up (the Horse on file 8 covers the second-rank point of file 4) or go to file 6 (the Black Horse is in the way), so it must take the Chariot and step onto file 5, the file the Red General controls.
entries.Thí xe thứ hai: xe 5 lui ăn sĩ chiếu. Cu: The second Chariot sacrifice: the Chariot on file 5 retreats to take the Advisor with check. Black's palace loses its last Advisor, and Black must take the Chariot with the General.
entries.Thí xe ăn pháo để kéo mã 8 đen về che, r: Sacrifice the Chariot to take the Cannon and pull Black's Horse on file 8 back to cover, then check with the two Soldiers one after another to drive the General to file 4 (winning a Chariot along the way), and finish with the two Red Horses working together to checkmate in 5 moves.
entries.Thí xe để kéo tướng đen vào lộ giữa, rồi: Sacrifice the Chariot to pull the Black General onto the central file, then use the Soldier on file 5 together with the flying General rule to push the General back and checkmate with a Soldier.
entries.Thí xe: xe 4 ăn pháo chiếu. Tướng đen kh: Chariot sacrifice: the Chariot on file 4 takes the Cannon with check. The Black General has no safe escape, so Black must take the Chariot with the Horse on file 8 (the Horse leaves the right flank and comes next to the palace) or take the Cannon on file 5 with the General.
entries.Thí xe: xe 4 ăn xe chiếu. Tướng không sa: Chariot sacrifice: the Chariot on file 4 takes the Chariot with check. The General cannot go to file 5 (the flying General rule), so it must take the Chariot and move up to the third rank on file 6.
entries.Thí xe: xe 6 ăn mã chiếu dọc lộ 4. Ngoài: Chariot sacrifice: the Chariot on file 6 takes the Horse with check up file 4. Besides gaining tempo, this removes Black's Horse on file 4, the piece that could jump back to block the central file when the Red Cannon shifts to file 5 at the end.
entries.Thế cờ hiện cân bằng; nếu đỏ chậm, đen l: The game is level for now; if Red is slow, Black retreats the General to the back rank (K6-1), secures the palace, and the two Black Horses start a counterattack. The chain of Soldier checks only works while the two Generals still face each other on the same file.
entries.Thế cờ hiện cân bằng; đen dọa X7.1 ăn tố: The game is level for now; Black threatens R7+1 to take the Soldier on file 3, the very Soldier that gives checkmate at the end. If Red does not strike now, Black takes the Soldier, secures the back rank, and Red misses the chance. The move +C=8 keeps an advantage but does not mate.
entries.Thế cờ đang cân bằng; nếu đỏ chậm, đen s: The game is level; if Red is slow, Black uses the Cannon and Chariot to chase away Red's Chariot on file 4, which is deep in Black's half, and Red has to retreat and lose the initiative.
entries.Tranh quyền kiểm soát lộ giữa: xe ăn phá: Fight for control of the central file: a Chariot takes the central Cannon with check, the second Chariot takes back the Chariot (getting the Red General out of check and checking), the Chariot goes on to take a Cannon to get out of check again and is sacrificed, and finally a Horse takes an Advisor with check and the Cannon shifts across to mate with the Horse as its screen.
entries.Tàn cuộc cần kỹ thuật: nếu đỏ chậm, đen: This endgame needs technique: if Red is slow, Black brings an Advisor back to the middle of the palace and the Cannon back to defend, and Red's win becomes very hard to achieve. The nice point is that the Red General is also an attacker: the flying General rule locks the central file throughout the exercise.
entries.Tướng chạy sang lộ 6 để giải chiếu. Đen: The General steps to file 6 to get out of check. Black takes the Horse on file 7, but the Black Chariot leaves file 4 and opens the way for Red's Chariot on file 6 to advance.
entries.Tướng sang lộ 4 tránh chiếu. Đen đã đổi: The General steps to file 4 out of check. Black has traded a Cannon for a Chariot and gone from behind to slightly ahead (Chariot and Horse against Cannon and 2 Horses).
entries.Tướng sang lộ 6 tránh chiếu. Đỏ hơn một: The General steps to file 6 out of check. Red is a Chariot up.
entries.Tướng tiến lên tầng 2 tránh chiếu — nước: The General moves up to the second rank out of check: the only move. The General stands on file 4, right below Red's Chariot on file 4, so a Black Chariot that checks along this file will be taken by the Red Chariot.
entries.Tướng tiến lên tầng 2 tránh chiếu, rời h: The General moves up to the second rank out of check, leaving the back rank where the Black Cannon could keep checking. Red keeps the extra Chariot.
entries.Tướng đỏ tiến lên ăn pháo đen: mặt tướng: The Red General moves up and takes the Black Cannon: the line between the Generals is open again and the mating threat is still there. The Black Cannon is unprotected, so the General takes it safely.
entries.Tướng đỏ đang bị pháo đen chiếu (xe 4 là: The Red General is in check from the Black Cannon (with the Chariot on file 4 as its screen). The Chariot on file 4 simply takes the Cannon: out of check, and checking the Black General back. Black must take the Chariot with an Advisor.

The Red General is in check from a Black Cannon (with the Chariot on file 4 as its screen). The Chariot advances and takes the Cannon: out of check, and checking the Black General. Black can only take the Chariot with the Horse on file 8.
entries.Tướng đỏ đang bị xe đen chiếu. Xe 2 bình: The Red General is in check from the Black Chariot. The Chariot on file 2 shifts across and takes the Black Chariot: out of check, and checking back. Black must block with the Cannon on file 6, an Advisor or an Elephant.
entries.Tượng 7 lui sang cánh, bỏ ngòi của pháo: The Elephant on file 7 retreats to the flank, removing the Black Cannon's screen: out of check without weakening the palace. Red still keeps the threat H3+1 against Black's Chariot on file 9. Black moves the Chariot by taking the Soldier on file 1.
entries.Tượng ăn mã. Đỏ còn hai pháo so với một: The Elephant takes the Horse. Red has two Cannons against Black's one Cannon, with all Advisors and Elephants: a winning endgame.
entries.Tượng đen lui về giữa nên lộ 3 thông: xe: The Black Elephant went back to the center, so file 3 is open and Black's Chariot on file 7 aims straight at the Cannon on file 3. The Cannon on file 6 advances one point and, with the Soldier on file 5 as its screen, protects the Cannon on file 3. Red keeps the gain: a Horse up.
entries.Tốt 2 bình chiếu sát tướng. Tướng không: The Soldier on file 2 shifts across with check right next to the General. The General cannot go to file 5 (an Advisor is in the way), so it must retreat to the back rank.
entries.Tốt 2 bình chiếu. Tướng không sang 5 (mặ: The Soldier on file 2 shifts across with check. The General cannot go to file 5 (the flying General rule) and cannot leave the palace, so it must retreat to the second rank.
entries.Tốt 3 bình chiếu sát tướng. Đen phải ăn: The Soldier on file 3 shifts across with check, right next to the General. Black must take the Soldier; if the General takes it, it steps onto file 6, the file the Red General controls.
entries.Tốt 3 bình ăn xe 6 và chiếu. Tướng phải: The Soldier on file 3 shifts across and takes the Chariot on file 6 with check. The General must go back to the back rank; if the remaining Black Chariot takes the Soldier, it leaves file 6 on the riverbank.
entries.Tốt 3 tiến xuống đáy, trở thành ngòi mới: The Soldier on file 3 advances to the back rank and becomes the new screen for the Cannon's check. The General cannot go to file 6 (the Soldier covers it), cannot go to file 4 (the Cannon covers it), and cannot move up (its own Black Horse is in the way), so it is checkmate.
entries.Tốt 4 tiến chiếu. Tướng không ăn được tố: The Soldier on file 4 advances with check. The General cannot take the Soldier (the Soldier on file 5 protects it) or go to file 5 (the Generals would face each other), so it is checkmate.
entries.Tốt 4 ăn xe chiếu. Tướng không ăn được t: The Soldier on file 4 takes the Chariot with check. The General cannot take the Soldier (it is protected by the Soldier on file 5) or go to file 5 (the Soldier on file 5 covers it), so it must retreat to the back rank.
entries.Tốt 5 bình chiếu. Tướng không lùi về đáy: The Soldier on file 5 shifts across with check. The General cannot retreat to the back rank (the Cannon covers it), cannot go to file 5 (the Horse on file 3 covers it), and cannot take the Soldier (the Horse on file 3 protects it), so it is checkmate. Cannon, Horse and Soldier work together perfectly.
entries.Tốt 5 bình ăn pháo chiếu. Tốt được mã 8: The Soldier on file 5 shifts across and takes the Cannon with check. The Soldier is protected by the Horse on file 8, so the General cannot take it; the General must step to file 5.
entries.Tốt 5 bình ăn sĩ chiếu. Tướng không ăn đ: The Soldier on file 5 shifts across and takes an Advisor with check. The General cannot take the Soldier because it would face the Red General, so it must retreat to the back rank (taking the Cannon on file 4). Red accepts losing the Cannon to get Soldiers pressing close.
entries.Tốt 5 tiến chiếu. Tướng không ăn được tố: The Soldier on file 5 advances with check. The General cannot take the Soldier because it would face the Red General, and cannot go to file 6 (the Black Horse is in the way), so it must step back to file 4.
entries.Tốt 6 tiến chiếu. Tốt được tốt 7 bảo vệ: The Soldier on file 6 advances with check. It is protected by the Soldier on file 7, so the General cannot take it and must go back to file 5.
entries.Tốt 6 tiến ăn sĩ, trở thành ngòi cho phá: The Soldier on file 6 advances to take an Advisor and becomes the screen for the Cannon on file 6, which checks up the file. Black must jump a Horse back to block the Cannon's line.
entries.Tốt 6 ăn xe 4 đen và chiếu. Tướng không: The Soldier on file 6 takes Black's Chariot on file 4 with check. The General cannot go back to file 6 (the Soldier on file 3 covers it) or move up (its own Black Horse is in the way), so it must take the Soldier and step onto file 4, right where the two Red Horses operate.
entries.Tốt 6 đỏ đang nằm trong tầm ăn của xe 2: Red's Soldier on file 6 is within reach of Black's Chariot on file 2 (R2=4). If Red loses one tempo, Black takes the Soldier and gains time to bring pieces back to defend; the game becomes level and Red's chance to checkmate is gone for good.
entries.Tốt 8 bình vào chiếu sát cạnh tướng. Phá: The Soldier on file 8 shifts across with check, right next to the General. Black's Cannon on file 3 has been lured away and cannot take the Soldier; Black must take it with the Elephant on file 5 (or the Chariot on file 1). Whichever piece takes it will stand on the back-rank point of file 7 and become the screen for Red's Cannon on file 8.
entries.Tốt bình chiếu. Tốt được tốt 6 bảo vệ, ô: The Soldier shifts in with check. It is protected by the Soldier on file 6, the second-rank point is covered by the Soldier on file 6, and the file 6 point is blocked by a Black Advisor, so it is checkmate.
entries.Tốt bình ăn tượng chiếu. Tướng không san: The Soldier shifts across and takes the Elephant with check. The General cannot go to file 6 (the Soldier has left file 6, so the Generals would face each other), cannot go to file 4 (the Horse on file 4 covers it), and cannot retreat to the back rank (the Cannon on file 2 covers it with the Horse on file 4 as its screen), so it is checkmate.
entries.Tốt giữa bình ăn xe — tiếp tục là nước ê: The middle Soldier shifts across and takes the Chariot, another quiet move that removes the last defender of the point in front of the General and threatens checkmate with B4t.1.
entries.Tốt sau tiến ăn nốt xe đen và chiếu. Tướ: The rear Soldier advances to take the last Black Chariot with check. The General cannot take the Horse on file 4 on the back rank (the Cannon on file 2 protects the Horse with the Elephant as its screen), so it must go back to file 5.
entries.Tốt sau tiến ăn xe 6 chiếu. Đen phải ăn: The rear Soldier advances and takes the Chariot on file 6 with check. Black must take the Soldier back: with the Cannon on file 4 (using an Elephant as its screen), with an Advisor, or with the General retreating to the back rank to take the Soldier there. If the Cannon takes, the Black Cannon stands on file 4 and gives a counter-check to the Red General (with Red's Chariot on file 4 as its screen).
entries.Tốt tiến chiếu từ bên cạnh. Tướng không: The Soldier advances and checks from the side.
