The General cannot go to file 5 (the flying General rule) or retreat (a Black Advisor is in the way), so it must move back up to the third rank. Now the Soldier on the second rank also covers the second-rank point of file 6.
entries.Tốt tiến chiếu. Tướng không ăn được tốt: The Soldier advances with check. The General cannot take it (the Generals would face each other), so it must step to file 5.
entries.Tốt tiến chiếu. Tốt được pháo 6 bảo vệ (: The Soldier advances with check. It is protected by the Cannon on file 6 (the Black Horse that just blocked becomes the screen), and the General cannot go to file 5 (the Soldier on file 4 covers it), so it is checkmate.
entries.Tốt tiến xuống đáy chiếu tướng từ bên cạ: The Soldier advances to the back rank and checks the General from the side. The General cannot move up (the Horse on file 8 covers it) or take the Soldier (it would face the Red General), so it is checkmate. The weakest piece ends the game by working with the flying General rule and the Horse.
entries.Tốt tiếp tục tiến xuống đáy, chiếu từ bê: The Soldier keeps advancing to the back rank and checks from the side. The General cannot take the Soldier (the Generals would face each other) or move up (its own Black Horse is in the way), so it must step to file 4.
The front Soldier on file 3 advances to the back rank with check. The only point the General can go to holds Red's Cannon on file 5, so Black must take the Cannon with the General and step onto the central file.
entries.Tốt trước của lộ 4 tiến chiếu. Tướng khô: The front Soldier on file 4 advances with check. The General cannot go to file 5 (the Soldier on file 5 covers it) or take the Soldier (the Soldier on file 5 protects it), so it is checkmate with Soldiers alone.
entries.Tốt ăn sĩ chiếu (chấp nhận mất pháo 4),: A Soldier takes an Advisor with check (accepting the loss of the Cannon on file 4), the Soldier keeps advancing to chase the General from file 6 across file 5 to file 4, each step protected by the flying General rule, then the Soldier on file 6 takes an Advisor to become the screen for the Cannon on file 6, and a Soldier gives checkmate.

Black is still behind in material. If Black exchanges and does not follow up fast, the Red Chariot escapes to a good point and Black slowly loses for lack of strong pieces.

Red's two Chariots are better placed and more active, but the Red Horse on file 9 is passive. Black's Horse on file 4 is stuck, within reach of Red's Chariot on file 2.

Red has a Chariot and 2 Cannons in attacking positions, but the Red Chariot's path to checkmate is blocked by Red's own Cannon on file 4.

entries.Về quân: Gần cân bằng (đỏ có 2 pháo, 2 t: Material: nearly level (Red has 2 Cannons and 2 Soldiers across the river; Black has 2 Horses, both Advisors and 2 Soldiers). entries.Về quân: Gần cân bằng (đỏ có xe, 2 pháo,: Material: nearly level (Red has a Chariot, 2 Cannons and a Horse; Black has a Chariot, a Cannon, 2 Horses and all Advisors and Elephants). entries.Về quân: Gần cân bằng (đỏ có xe, 3 tốt q: Material: nearly level (Red has a Chariot and 3 Soldiers across the river; Black has a Chariot, a Horse, both Advisors and 2 Soldiers). entries.Về quân: Gần cân bằng (đỏ có xe, pháo, m: Material: nearly level (Red has a Chariot, a Cannon and a Horse; Black has a Chariot, a Horse and all Advisors and Elephants). entries.Về quân: Gần cân bằng, giai đoạn trung c: Material: nearly level, in the early middlegame (both sides have all their Advisors and Elephants). Black's Chariot and Horse on file 2 have swarmed onto Red's left flank: the Black Chariot on file 2, on the second rank in Red's half, is attacking Red's Cannon on file 7 along the same rank. Red's Cannon on file 7 stands between Red's Chariot on file 2 and Black's Chariot on file 2.
entries.Về quân: Gần ngang nhau, đỏ nhỉnh hơn vì: Material: nearly level, with Red slightly better thanks to the Chariot (Red has a Chariot, a Cannon and a Horse; Black has 2 Cannons, a Horse and all Advisors and Elephants). The Black General is on the back rank of file 5, with two Advisors (one on the back rank of file 4, one in the middle of the palace) and Black's Cannon on file 5 right in front of the palace; the Elephant on file 7 on the back rank shields the General from Red's Chariot on file 2. entries.Về quân: Hai bên cân bằng, giai đoạn kha: Material: level, in the opening (all pieces on the board). entries.Về quân: Hai bên gần ngang nhau (mỗi bên: Material: nearly level (each side has 2 Chariots; Red has a Cannon, a Horse and both Elephants; Black has 2 Cannons, a Horse and all Advisors and Elephants). entries.Xe bình ăn xe 5 đen. Đen phản công bằng: The Chariot shifts and takes Black's Chariot on file 5. Black counterattacks with a Horse check.
entries.Xe bình ăn xe đen. Đỏ đổi mã lấy xe, từ: The Chariot shifts across and takes the Black Chariot. Red has traded a Horse for a Chariot and gone from behind to ahead in material.
entries.Xe lui chiếu theo hàng ngang. Tướng đen: The Chariot retreats with a check along the rank. The Black General can only step back to the second rank, and once the General leaves, Black's Chariot on file 5 stands alone without protection.
entries.Xe lui về hàng của mã 4: rời hàng ngang: The Chariot retreats to the rank of the Horse on file 4: it leaves the rank so the Cannon on file 8 checks through the Red Advisor as a screen (discovered check), and at the same time the Chariot attacks the Horse. Red must get out of check and cannot save the Horse.
entries.Xe lui ăn pháo. Đen đổi lại bằng mã ăn p: The Chariot retreats and takes the Cannon. Black trades back with the Horse taking Red's Cannon on file 4 with check.
entries.Xe lui ăn xe 3 đen. Đỏ chuyển từ kém quâ: The Chariot retreats and takes Black's Chariot on file 3. Red goes from behind in material to a full Chariot up, and the Chariot comes back to help defend the rear ranks.
entries.Xe lui ăn xe 7 đen. Đỏ hơn hẳn một xe, p: The Chariot retreats and takes Black's Chariot on file 7. Red is a full Chariot up, and the central Cannon and two Soldiers keep the attack going.
entries.Xe lui ăn xe 8 đen. Đỏ đổi pháo lấy xe,: The Chariot retreats and takes Black's Chariot on file 8. Red has traded a Cannon for a Chariot and is clearly ahead in material.
entries.Xe sau tiến ăn xe chiếu (thí xe thứ hai): The rear Chariot advances and takes the Chariot with check (the second Chariot sacrifice). The General cannot move up (the Soldier on file 5 covers it), so it must take the Chariot and step onto file 6.
The Chariot drops to the second rank in Red's half and checks the General. Red must raise an Advisor to the middle to block, and that Advisor will become the screen for Black's Cannon on file 8.
entries.Xe tiến xuống đáy sân đỏ chiếu. Đỏ phải: The Chariot drops to the back rank in Red's half with check. Red must bring an Elephant or an Advisor back to block.
entries.Xe tiến ăn mã. Đen phản công bằng xe chi: The Chariot advances and takes the Horse. Black counterattacks with a Chariot check along the back rank.
entries.Xe tiến ăn tượng chiếu. Đen chỉ có thể đ: The Chariot advances and takes the Elephant with check. Black can only bring an Advisor to the middle of the palace to block, and that very Advisor becomes the screen for the Cannon on file 5.
entries.Xe tiếp tục lui về đáy, chặn giữa pháo đ: The Chariot keeps retreating to the back rank and stands between the Black Cannon and the Red Advisor: with two screens, the Black Cannon cannot check. Red is a Chariot up, and the mating threat is gone.
entries.Xe trước bình vào lộ giữa chiếu tướng. Đ: The front Chariot shifts to the central file and checks the General. Black must raise an Advisor to block, and the Advisor becomes the screen for the Cannon on file 5.
entries.Xe trước bình vào lộ giữa chiếu để kéo s: Shift the front Chariot to the central file with check to pull a Black Advisor in as a screen, then shift that Chariot to file 2 for a discovered check by the Cannon on file 5, landing on the same file as Black's Chariot on file 8; when Black takes the Cannon to get out of check, Red retreats the Chariot and takes the Chariot.
entries.Xe trước của đỏ đang bị xe 6 đen bắt. Nế: Red's front Chariot is being attacked by Black's Chariot on file 6. If Red is slow, Black takes the Chariot and Red loses the attack. Retreating the Chariot (+R-1) keeps an advantage but does not mate.
entries.Xe trước tiến ăn pháo chiếu (thí xe). Đe: The front Chariot advances and takes the Cannon with check (a Chariot sacrifice). Black must take back with the Chariot on file 6 or with the General.
entries.Xe trước ăn pháo chặn, tiếp tục chiếu. Đ: The front Chariot takes the blocking Cannon and keeps checking. Black takes the Chariot with the Horse on file 4.
entries.Xe trước ăn xe chặn và tiếp tục chiếu. Đ: The front Chariot takes the blocking Chariot and keeps checking. Black again has to put a piece in the way.
entries.Xe ăn mã 4. Đen hơn một mã, đủ sĩ tượng;: The Chariot takes the Horse on file 4. Black is a Horse up with all Advisors and Elephants; the Red General is still weak because Black's Cannon on file 8 is still deep in Red's half.
entries.Xe ăn mã. Đen từ kém quân thành hơn một: The Chariot takes the Horse. Black goes from behind in material to a Horse up.
entries.Xe ăn nốt xe chiếu. Tướng không lùi về đ: The Chariot takes the last Chariot with check. The General cannot retreat to the back rank (the Horse on file 6 covers it), cannot go to file 4 (the Cannon on file 6 covers it through the Horse screen), cannot move forward (the Soldier on file 5 covers it), and going to file 6 runs into the Chariot, so it is checkmate.
entries.Xe ăn pháo chiếu, sau đó lui xe về phòng: Take the Cannon with the Chariot, giving check, then pull the Chariot back to defend before the Black Chariot can check, move the General out of check, and use a Cannon check to steady the position: Red ends a full Cannon up in the endgame.
entries.Xe ăn pháo chiếu: vừa hóa giải nước chiế: The Chariot takes the Cannon with check: it stops the check from Black's Cannon on file 6 and checks the General at the same time. The Black General has nowhere to go (file 4 is covered by the Chariot along the back rank, and moving up runs into its own Advisor), so Black must take the Chariot, and the piece that takes it leaves its defensive post.
entries.Xe ăn pháo đầu: xóa nước chiếu của đen v: The Chariot takes the central Cannon: it removes Black's check and checks the General at the same time. Black must take the Chariot with the Horse on file 4 or one of the two Elephants.
entries.Xe ăn sĩ chiếu. Tướng không lên tầng 2 (: The Chariot takes the Advisor with check. The General cannot move up to the second rank (the Soldier on file 3 covers it) or go to file 5 (the Chariot covers it), so it is checkmate.
entries.Xe ăn sĩ chiếu. Tướng đỏ buộc phải lên t: The Chariot takes the Advisor with check. The Red General must move up to the second rank with no Advisors or Elephants left to shelter it; Black is two defenders up and keeps the attack.
entries.Xe ăn tượng chiếu (thí xe). Đen buộc phả: The Chariot takes the Elephant with check (a Chariot sacrifice). Black must take the Chariot with the Horse on file 9, and the Black Horse lands on the back rank, becoming the screen for a Red Cannon.
entries.Xe ăn tượng chiếu tiếp. Đỏ chỉ còn sĩ để: The Chariot takes the Elephant and checks again. Red has only the Advisor left to block.
entries.Xe ăn tượng chiếu để kéo sĩ đen vào làm: Take the Elephant with the Chariot, giving check, to pull a Black Advisor in as a screen; shift the Chariot to file 3 so the central Cannon gives a discovered check, then retreat the Chariot to take Black's Chariot on file 7.
The Chariot takes the Elephant with check, removing the piece blocking the central file. Black must put an Advisor in the middle of the palace to block, and that Advisor will become the screen for the Cannon on file 5.
entries.Xe ăn tốt để giải chiếu và chiếu ngược t: Take the Soldier with the Chariot to get out of check and give a counter-check up file 4, then take the blocking Horse as well (again getting out of check and checking), and then the two Red Horses take turns checking until checkmate, with the flying General rule locking file 5.
entries.Xe ăn tốt: giải chiếu và đồng thời chiếu: The Chariot takes the Soldier: it gets out of check and checks the Black General up file 4. Black must block or take the Chariot.
entries.Xe ăn xe 9 đỏ. Đen đổi pháo lấy xe, hơn: The Chariot takes Red's Chariot on file 9. Black has traded a Cannon for a Chariot and is clearly ahead in material.
entries.Xe ăn xe chiếu. Tướng không có ô chạy (m: Chariot takes Chariot with check. The General has nowhere to go (its own Horse and Advisor are in the way), so it must take the Chariot and step onto file 4.
entries.Xe ăn xe chặn, tiếp tục chiếu. Đen chỉ c: The Chariot takes the blocking Chariot and keeps checking. Black has only the Advisor on file 5 left to block.
The Chariot takes the blocking Chariot and keeps checking. Black has only the Chariot on file 7 left to block.
entries.Xe ăn xe để tượng đen phải ăn lại và đứn: Chariot takes Chariot so the Black Elephant must take back and land on file 3; that gives Red's Cannon on file 3 the Elephant as a screen to retreat and take Black's Horse on file 7. Then the Cannon on file 6 advances one point to protect the Cannon on file 3 from the Black Chariot.
entries.Xe đen chiếu theo lộ giữa; tướng đỏ chạy: The Black Chariot checks along the central file; the Red General steps to file 6 out of check.
entries.Xe đen chạy sang lộ nào (X6-5, X6-3, X6-: Whichever file the Black Chariot moves to (R6=5, R6=3, R6=2), Red takes the Cannon with C1-4.
entries.Xe đỏ đang bị bắt. Lui xe (X9/2) vẫn giữ: The Red Chariot is under attack. Retreating it (R9-2) keeps an advantage but does not finish the game, and Black slowly deals with the two Red Soldiers; slower still, Black takes the Chariot and wins. Red must strike while the Black General is boxed in by its own pieces.
entries.bắt xe và chuẩn bị chiếu bắt xe: Attack the Chariot and prepare a check that wins it.
entries.chiếu bằng xe, dùng pháo để cản 2 quân m: Check with the Chariot, using the Cannon to stop Black's two strong pieces on file 8 from coming back to defend.
entries.chiếu tướng bắt xe: Check the General and attack the Chariot.
entries.chiếu tướng bắt xe, đổi pháo lấy xe: Check the General while attacking the Chariot, trading a Cannon for a Chariot.
entries.chiếu đôi bắt xe đen: Double check that wins the Black Chariot.
entries.chiếu để chuẩn bị chiếu đôi và bắt xe ở: Check, preparing a double check that wins the Chariot on the next move.
entries.chiếu, dồn tướng vào vị trí xấu: Check, driving the General to a bad point.
entries.chiếu, lấy mặt tướng, chiếu hết trong 2: Check, use the flying General rule, checkmate in 2 moves.
entries.chiếu, phối hợp quân để sử dụng quân xe: Check, coordinating the pieces to bring Red's Chariot on file 1 into play.
entries.dùng mã chiếu, chuẩn bị chiếu hết trong: Check with the Horse, preparing checkmate in 2 moves if Black moves the General, or in 3 moves if Black takes the Horse with the Chariot.
entries.dùng mã đỏ ăn xe chiếu: Take the Chariot with a Red Horse, giving check.
entries.dùng pháo 1 chiếu để loại bỏ quân phòng: Check with the Cannon on file 1 to remove Black's defender.
entries.dùng pháo 1 đỏ chiếu, chuẩn bị chiếu hết: Check with the Red Cannon on file 1, preparing checkmate in 1 move.
entries.dùng pháo 4 chiếu để mở đường cho xe chi: Check with the Cannon on file 4 to open the way for the Chariot to mate in 1 move.
entries.dùng pháo đỏ chiếu, chuẩn bị chiếu hết t: Check with a Red Cannon, preparing checkmate in 1 move.
entries.dùng tốt ăn mã chiếu, triệt tiêu quân ph: Take the Horse with the Soldier, giving check, to eliminate Black's strong defender.
entries.dùng tốt đỏ ăn xe chiếu: Take the Chariot with a Red Soldier, giving check.
entries.dùng xe 8 chiếu và chuẩn bị đổi quân mạn: Check with the Chariot on file 8 and prepare to trade off the strong piece defending Black's file 6.
entries.dùng xe chiếu, chuẩn bị chiếu hết trong: Check with the Chariot, preparing checkmate in 2 moves.
entries.dùng xe đỏ ăn pháo đen chiếu: Take the Black Cannon with a Red Chariot, giving check.
entries.dùng xe đỏ ăn pháo đen chiếu, buộc tượng: Take the Black Cannon with a Red Chariot, giving check, forcing the Black Elephant back so the Red Cannon on file 1 has a screen to check.
entries.dùng xe đỏ ăn xe đen chiếu: Take the Black Chariot with a Red Chariot, giving check.
entries.khi đen M7.8 thì chưa được phép ăn mã đe: After Black H7+8, do not capture the Black Horse yet: it would come back and fork both Red Chariots.
entries.lên xe để hai xe liên kết nhau để tránh: Advance the Chariot so the two Chariots protect each other and Black cannot bring H8-6 around to guard the Horse on file 4.
entries.nếu không ăn tốt mà Tg6.1 thì sẽ bị M1.2: If Black does not take the Soldier but plays K6+1, H1+2 is checkmate in 1 move.
entries.nếu vội vàng P4/2 thì đen sẽ chạy mã đi: If Red rushes C4-2, Black moves the Horse away, there is no checkmate, and Red loses instead.
entries.nếu vội vàng dùng pháo 2 đỏ chiếu trước: If Red rushes a check with the Cannon on file 2 first, E7+9 leaves Red's Cannon on file 1 stuck with no check, and Red loses instead.
entries.nếu đen chạy xe ngang thì sẽ bị chiếu hế: If Black moves the Chariot sideways, the double-Cannon mate on file 4 follows. If Black takes the Cannon with the Advisor, P6=5 mates with the Soldier.
entries.nếu đen dùng tướng ăn tốt thì sẽ bị M1/3: If Black takes the Soldier with the General, then H1-3, then +H+2 and H3+2 is checkmate in 3 moves.
entries.nếu đen không dùng pháo ăn xe và về tướn: If Black does not take the Chariot with the Cannon and moves the General back, the next attacking moves are much the same.
entries.nếu đen không dùng xe ăn xe mà dùng pháo: If Black does not take the Chariot with the Chariot but pulls the Cannon back to defend, +R=3 is checkmate at once.
entries.nếu đen không lùi pháo về mà lùi tượng v: If Black does not pull the Cannon back but retreats an Elephant, then R2=3; +C-6, C1+5 is checkmate.
entries.nếu đen không ăn xe 3 mà TH1: về sĩ thì: If Black does not take the Chariot on file 3: case 1, if the Advisor goes back, R3=6 is checkmate; case 2, if Black takes the Chariot or the Cannon comes back, R3+1 checks and then mates along the bottom rank.
entries.nếu đen không ăn xe mà lui tướng về thì: If Black does not take the Chariot but moves the General back, it is checkmate in one move.
entries.thí mã chiếu mở lộ cho 2 xe tấn công tướ: Sacrifice the Horse with check to open a path for the 2 Chariots to attack the General.
entries.thí pháo 9 đỏ để buộc xe phải ăn lên: Sacrifice Red's Cannon on file 9 to force the Chariot to take it.
entries.thí tốt để đưa tướng vào vị trí xấu dễ d: Sacrifice a Soldier to draw the General onto a bad point where the two Cannons can work together to checkmate.
entries.thí xe triệt tiêu quân phòng thủ của đen: Sacrifice the Chariot to eliminate Black's defender and force the Black General onto a bad point.
entries.thí xe đỏ chiếu để tạo ngòi phối hợp cho: Sacrifice a Red Chariot with check to create a screen so the Cannons on file 9 and file 7 can work together.
entries.trường hợp này tương tự với V5/3: This case is similar to E5-3.
entries.ăn pháo chiếu buộc xe đen kéo về: Take the Cannon with check, forcing the Black Chariot to come back.
entries.ăn tốt, đổi xe và chiếu: Take the Soldier, trade Chariots, and check.
entries.ăn xe đen, pháo đen ăn ngược lại xe đỏ: Capture the Black Chariot; the Black Cannon takes back the Red Chariot.
entries.Đang kém nhiều quân nên nếu không tấn cô: Red is far behind in material, so if the attack is not fast enough Black will either attack first or pull pieces back to defend, and Red will lose.
entries.Đang kém quân mạnh nên nếu không tấn côn: Red is behind in strong pieces, so if the attack is not fast enough Black will either attack first or pull pieces back to defend, and Red will lose.
entries.Đen chỉ kéo dài được bằng P6-7: pháo bìn: Black can only drag things out with C6=7: the Cannon shifts to file 7 so it can use a Soldier as a screen to take the Horse when it jumps in. Every other move loses at once to H1+3.
entries.Đen chỉ kéo dài được bằng P7-5: pháo về: Black can only drag things out with C7=5: the Cannon comes back to the central file to block the line between the Generals. Every other move loses at once to C9=4.
entries.Đen chỉ kéo dài được bằng X7-6 (bình xe: Black can only drag things out with R7=6 (shifting the Chariot back to guard the point in front of the General); every other move, including taking a Soldier with R7=5, loses at once to P4+1. Do not rush the P4+1 check on this move: the General escapes to file 5.
entries.Đen có thể P2/7 hoặc S5.6; đỏ tiếp tục c: Black can play C2-7 or A5+6; Red keeps checking with the Chariot and keeps the advantage.
entries.Đen có thể che bằng V7.5, M4/5 hoặc chạy: Black can block with E7+5 or H4-5, or move the General with K5=6; either way Red takes the Chariot with R7-6.
entries.Đen dọa P3.4 chiếu và dùng hai pháo, hai: Black threatens C3+4 with check and an attack on the Red General with two Cannons and two Horses (according to the engine, Red loses badly if slow). Defending with E3+5 is not enough either.
entries.Đen dọa P9-5 ăn tốt 5 chiếu. Nếu đỏ chậm: Black threatens C9=5, taking the Soldier on file 5 with check. If Red is slow, Red loses the Soldier and the central Cannon's pressure, and ends up losing. Note: checking with R5=3 right away (before taking the Elephant) only keeps the balance.
entries.Đen dọa X5-6 ăn tốt 4 và củng cố cung; n: Black threatens R5=6 to take the Soldier on file 4 and shore up the palace; if Red is slow, the shield in front of the Black General gets stronger and Red loses the attack. Red's file 4 is a double-edged sword: right after the first move, a Black Cannon taking the Soldier checks the Red General straight down this file, and Red must get out of check with a check.
entries.Đen dọa X5-6 ăn xe 4 kèm chiếu. Nếu đỏ m: Black threatens R5=6, taking the Chariot on file 4 with check. If Red loses a tempo, the Chariot on file 4 is lost and the Red General comes under attack. Red must check without a break; on the 5th move the Red General itself is checked by a Black Cannon (with a Red Chariot as its screen) and must get out of check with a capture that gives check.
entries.Đen dọa X7.2 ăn tượng chiếu và tấn công: Black threatens R7+2, taking an Elephant with check and launching a relentless attack (according to the engine, Red loses badly if slow). A passive defense such as K4=5 also loses. Red must counterattack with a strong threat and calculate the General's escape route exactly.
entries.Đen dọa Xt-5 ăn tốt 5 — quân tốt đang gi: Black threatens +R=5 to take the Soldier on file 5, the Soldier that locks the palace. If Red is slow, Black takes the Soldier and brings the Chariots back to defend; Red has no Chariot, so there will be no way to checkmate and Red slowly loses for lack of strong pieces.
entries.Đen dọa chiếu hết trong 1 nước (P9.7). N: Black threatens checkmate in 1 move (C9+7). Red's move must win tempo (a check) and prepare the defense; if Red only defends, Red cannot win the Chariot. Taking the Cannon first with R3=1 loses according to the engine.
entries.Đen dọa chiếu hết trong 1 nước, nên đỏ b: Black threatens checkmate in 1 move, so Red is forced to check without a break; a single move without check loses at once. Every defensive try (for example A4-5) leaves Black with an overwhelming material advantage.
entries.Đen dọa chiếu hết trong 1 nước, nên đỏ p: Black threatens checkmate in 1 move, so Red must check from start to finish. R4+4 (Chariot takes Chariot, the Black Horse takes back) also keeps an advantage but does not mate; this exercise asks you to see that the Soldier sacrifice is the move that both defends and attacks.
entries.Đen dọa chiếu hết trong 1 nước, và theo: Black threatens checkmate in 1 move, and according to the engine every Red move without check loses. Red must check on all 6 moves; one wrong move and Red is checkmated.
entries.Đen dọa chiếu hết trong 2 nước, nên đỏ p: Black threatens checkmate in 2 moves, so Red must check without a break. Shifting the Cannon to the wrong file (for example C5=2) leaves Red clearly worse.
entries.Đen dọa chiếu hết trong 3 nước, và theo: Black threatens checkmate in 3 moves, and according to the engine every Red move without check loses from the 2nd move on. Every move must be a check.
entries.Đen lên sĩ, ra xe hay bình pháo thì đỏ đ: Whether Black raises an Advisor, develops the Chariot or shifts a Cannon, Red takes the Horse with H6+5.
entries.Đen lùi tướng hay di chuyển sĩ thì đỏ vẫ: Whether Black moves the General back or moves an Advisor, Red still takes the Horse with H4-5.
entries.Đen đang bị chiếu nên phải xử lý ngay. G: Black is in check and must deal with it now. A passive defense such as A6+5 keeps the position but misses the chance to win material: Red's central Cannon has gone deep with nothing protecting it.
entries.Đen đang có nước chiếu hết trong 1 nước: Black has a checkmate in 1 move, so Red loses without a fast attack.
entries.Đen đang hơn một xe. Nếu đỏ chậm một nhị: Black is a Chariot up. If Red loses one tempo, Black plays R1+1 and takes the Horse on file 9 at once, the very piece that delivers the final checkmate, and Red no longer has enough force to attack. On the other hand, the Black General has no free point right now, so every Red check carries weight: this is the moment to strike.
entries.Đen đang kém nhẹ; nếu đen chậm, đỏ cải t: Black is slightly behind; if Black is slow, Red improves the position (H5+6, P5+1) and Black gets squeezed. Red's weak point is the Horse on the central file, separated from the General by just one Advisor; Black must use it now.
entries.Đen đang kém quân; nếu đi chậm, đỏ dùng: Black is behind in material; if Black is slow, Red uses the Chariot and two Horses to attack Black's palace (for example R4=2 followed by a check with H2+3) and Black loses. This is the only chance to turn the game around, because the Red Chariot stands where it has no way back. If R3+2 takes the Elephant, Red keeps the advantage.
entries.Đen đi trước. Bình pháo 5 sang lộ 3 tạo: Black to move. Shift the Cannon on file 5 to file 3 to stack the Cannons and attack Red's Chariot on file 7; when the Red Chariot moves away, the Black Chariot on file 4 drops to the second rank in Red's half and attacks Red's Chariot on file 9. That Red Chariot cannot take the Black Chariot, because the stacked Black Cannons would drop to the back rank and checkmate; Red can only win back a Cannon, and Black wins the Chariot.
entries.Đen đi trước. Dùng mã ăn pháo đầu để giả: Black to move. Capture the central Cannon with the Horse to get out of check; when the Red Chariot takes Black's Chariot on file 8, retreat the Horse with a discovered check (Black's Cannon on file 5 uses a Red Soldier as its screen) and then win back the Chariot. Black ends a Cannon up.
entries.Đen đi trước. Mã chiếu đẩy tướng đỏ sang: Black to move. Check with the Horse to push the Red General to file 4, then retreat the Horse with another check that also attacks Red's Cannon on file 6 (a Horse fork of General and Cannon), and finally take the Cannon with the Horse.
entries.Đen đi trước. Pháo 2 lui một mạch về tần: Black to move. Pull the Cannon on file 2 all the way back to the second rank, using the Advisor on file 5 as a screen to attack the Red Chariot. The Red Chariot is trapped on that rank (moving up to the back rank, the General takes it; moving down, the Advisor on file 6 is in the way), so Black wins the Chariot and then moves the General out of the Horse's check.
entries.Đen đi trước. Pháo 4 lấy mã làm ngòi ăn: Black to move. The Cannon on file 4 takes Red's Cannon on file 6 with the Horse as its screen, forcing Red's Advisor on file 5 to leave the middle of the palace to take back; once the central file is open, Red's Horse on file 5 is pinned to the General, and the Black Chariot shifts to file 5 to attack and win the Horse.
entries.Đen đi trước. Sau khi đổi xe xong sẽ tấn: Black to move. After the Chariot exchange, attack the piece that is in the line of fire and the two weak Horses.
entries.Đen đi trước. Xe 7 tiến chiếu buộc đỏ đư: Black to move. Advance the Chariot on file 7 with check to force Red to raise an Advisor to block, then retreat the Chariot with a discovered check (the Cannon on file 8 uses the Red Advisor as its screen) and use that tempo to take the Horse on file 4.
entries.Đen đi trước. Xe xuống đáy chiếu liên tụ: Black to move. The Chariot drops to the back rank and checks without a break: it takes an Elephant and then an Advisor, each with check, so Red has no time to counterattack. The Red General loses all its shelter, and Black has a winning endgame.
entries.Đen đáp bằng Tg4/1 hay S5/4 thì đỏ vẫn X: Whether Black answers with K4-1 or A5-4, Red still takes the Horse with R3+4; after the R9+2 check, Red retreats an Advisor to block and keeps the material.
entries.Đây là cách giải chiếu giữ được ưu thế t: According to the engine, this is the way out of check that best keeps the advantage.
entries.Đây là hình cờ đối công nên nếu không tấ: This is a race between two attacks: if Red does not strike first, Red can lose instead, because the Red General is exposed and Black currently has more strong pieces.
entries.Đây là nước giải chiếu duy nhất giữ được: This is the only way out of check that keeps the advantage; Red does not need to move the General.
entries.Đây là nước đáp duy nhất của đen. Chiếu: This is Black's only reply. Checking right away with P2=3 (without the Cannon sacrifice) only keeps a small advantage and does not mate.
entries.Đây là nước đáp duy nhất của đen. P6-4 v: This is Black's only reply. C6=4 still keeps a big advantage but does not mate.
entries.Đây là nước đáp duy nhất của đen. X2-3 (: This is Black's only reply. R2=3 (the Chariot takes the Elephant at once) still keeps a big advantage but does not mate.
entries.Đây là nước đáp duy nhất. Không được P8-: This is the only reply. Do not take the Cannon right away with C8=6: Black checks with R6=4 and Red loses material.
entries.Đây là nước đáp duy nhất. Lui xe sai số: This is the only reply. Retreating the Chariot by the wrong number of points (for example R6-7) does not attack the Black Chariot.
entries.Đây là nước đáp duy nhất. Lúc này xe đen: This is the only reply. By now the Black Chariot has come down next to Red's palace, so every Red move without check loses.
entries.Đây là nước đáp duy nhất. Nếu X8/8 ăn ph: This is the only reply. If R8-8 takes the Cannon right away, Black plays R5+5 to take the Cannon on file 5 and the game is level.
entries.Đây là thế 'được ăn cả, ngã về không': t: This is all or nothing: according to the engine, every other way out of check (including K5=4) leads to being checkmated. Only R7=6, getting out of check with a check, saves Red and turns the game around.
entries.Đây là thế đối công: thay vì phòng thủ,: This is a race between two attacks: instead of defending, the Cannon on file 5 takes an Advisor to wreck Black's palace, forcing Black to use up the checks. The Red General moves up to the second rank out of check, and when a Black Chariot checks up file 4, Red's Chariot on file 4 retreats and takes it.
entries.Đỏ có thể S5.4 (bỏ ngòi), Tg6/1 hoặc S5/: Red can play A5+4 (removing the screen), K6-1 or A5-6; either way Black takes the Horse with R7=6. If Black plays E7+9 instead of the discovered check, Red rescues the Horse and Black is worse.
entries.Đỏ không có quân mạnh nên không thể đánh: Red has no strong pieces, so Red cannot play a long game: if Red is slow, the Black Chariots pick off the Soldier chain and Red is lost. Red must strike while the Black General is stuck on the second rank. The hard part is that both middle moves are quiet moves, which means calculating exactly what each Soldier move threatens.
entries.Đỏ kém gần hai xe và đen đang dọa chiếu: Red is nearly two Chariots down and Black threatens checkmate in 2 moves, so every Red move must be a check or a mating threat that leaves Black no time to counterattack. One slow move loses at once.
entries.Đỏ kém gần như toàn bộ quân mạnh; chỉ cầ: Red is down almost all the strong pieces; one tempo is enough for Black to play R4+1, take the Soldier on file 6 and start attacking. Every Red move must be a check or a mating threat that Black cannot answer with a check.
entries.Đỏ kém một xe. Nếu đi chậm, đen sẽ dùng: Red is a Chariot down. If Red is slow, Black attacks with the Horse on file 3 and the Chariot on file 4 (for example R4=5 taking a Soldier). The sequence of checks must start while the two Soldiers still have the Black General boxed in; Red's second-best move (H8-7) already lets Black take over.
entries.Đỏ đang bị chiếu nên không có thời gian: Red is in check, so there is no time for slow moves. If Red only moves the General or blocks passively, Black, who is ahead in material with the Chariot on file 3 and the Soldier on file 2 pressing on Red's palace, counterattacks very quickly. This exercise tests whether you see that the best way out of check is also an attacking move.
entries.Đỏ đang bị chiếu. Cách giải chiếu tự nhi: Red is in check. The most natural way out is A4+5 taking the Soldier, but according to the engine that only keeps the balance; only the General move keeps the attack going.
entries.Đỏ đang bị chiếu. Giải chiếu bằng P7-5 t: Red is in check. Getting out of check with C7=5 leaves Red clearly worse (according to the engine). This exercise is about getting out of check actively and then using the open Chariot file.
entries.Đỏ đang bị chiếu. Giải chiếu thụ động (n: Red is in check. A passive defense (such as A6+5) keeps the material advantage but misses the chance to finish the game. This exercise teaches that when your General is in check, you should look for a way out of check that is also a check.
entries.Đỏ đang bị chiếu. Theo engine, giải chiế: Red is in check. According to the engine, getting out of check with A5-6 leads to checkmate in 2 moves. This exercise tests choosing the right piece to get out of check.
entries.Đỏ đang có nước chiếu pháo bắt xe. Sau k: Red has a Cannon check that attacks the Chariot. After the Horse captures, take the Chariot; if the Cannon takes the Red Chariot, keep going with a Horse check that wins a Chariot, and Red comes out ahead in strong pieces.
entries.Đỏ đang có thể ăn tượng chiếu và chiếu h: Red can take an Elephant with check and deliver a dangerous checkmate with the two Horses and the Chariot on file 9.
entries.Đỏ đang hơn thế, nhưng nếu đi chậm, đen: Red has the better position, but if Red is slow, Black gets the General over to file 6 in time (while Red's Horse on file 4 is still blocking the line between the Generals) or brings pieces back to defend, and Red keeps only a small advantage.
entries.Đỏ đang kém một xe và đen dọa X6-4 chiếu: Red is a Chariot down and Black threatens R6=4 with check and then winning a Horse; if Red is slow, Red is clearly lost on material. Red must check without a break to win tempo.
entries.Đổi xe để kéo tướng sang lộ 4, tốt 6 chi: Trade Chariots to pull the General to file 4, check with the Soldier on file 6 to push it back, then play a quiet Soldier move to the back rank and mate with a Soldier: the Black General is smothered by its own pieces.
entries.đang có nước mã chiếu tướng bắt xe: Red now has a Horse check that wins a Chariot.
entries.đổi quân phòng thủ lộ 6 của đen: Trade off the piece defending Black's file 6.
entries.đổi xe để quân mã 3 đỏ mất nước phải lui: Exchange Chariots so Red's Horse on file 3 loses time retreating; then jump the Horse in and use the Cannon to attack the Red Chariot.
